comment: How far from the camera each level is drawn out to, from shield_level_reaches_by_detail

name: shield_level_count
comment: The levels of detail, 6

name: shield_level_grids
comment: Each level's slices around and bands down: 16 by 14, 12 by 10, 10 by 8, 8 by 6, 6 by 4, 4 by 4

name: shield_level_reaches_by_detail
comment: The six reaches for each detail: from 1250 to 40000, 2500 to 80000, 10000 to 320000

name: capshields
comment: The capital shields showing, 50 of 0x3C bytes: the node, its copy, when it ends, when it last moved, eight hits, the next, a force field

name: capshield_next
comment: The capital shields' pool slot the next takes

name: shieldfx_create
comment: What a hit leaves where it struck, 12 bytes, by kind: 2 a hull hit, an orange emitter facing out from the surface and ARMOUR01 at the point in the part's frame, or PLAYERHIT on the player's ship at most every 30 ticks; 3 a component hit, a burst of 20; 4 a grey emitter; 5 sound 71 and 0x00472780

name: mesh_nearest_surface
comment: The point of a node's mesh nearest a point in the world, by each front-facing polygon's nearest point (simplex_nearest_point), and the surface's normal there

name: shieldfx_init
comment: Once: gunflare_sfxalpha1, and the orange and grey templates of what a hit leaves

name: shieldfx_free
comment: Frees what a hit left, and the emitter of kinds 2 to 4

name: shieldfx_deinit
comment: Frees the two templates

name: node_add_effect
comment: Hangs what a hit left from the node struck, as a node of kind 6 in a free child slot; for kind 3 it first clears nearby ones and the oldest past ten, and flares a shield generator's capital shield instead

name: shieldfx_orange
comment: The orange template of what a hit leaves: 100-tick particles growing from 50 to 100, fading from orange

name: shieldfx_grey
comment: The grey template of what a hit leaves: 50-tick particles growing from 25 to 50

name: player_hit_at
comment: When a shot last sounded PLAYERHIT on the player's hull

name: shieldfx_ready
comment: Set once shieldfx_init has run

name: shieldfx_texture
comment: gunflare_sfxalpha1

name: vec3_cosine
comment: The cosine of the angle between two vectors

name: sound3d_definitions
comment: The 3D sounds, closed by a record whose entry is -1

name: sound3d_class_rows
comment: Each 3D voice's class, 32 to a row: for up to 14 voices, up to 30, and more

name: sound3d_class_names
comment: Names of the voice classes, 30 characters each

name: engine_sound_rates
comment: The player's engine sound's playback rate at no throttle, by ship type

name: engine_sound_rates_by_throttle
comment: What full throttle adds to it

name: engine_sound_volumes
comment: Its volume at no throttle

name: engine_sound_volumes_by_throttle
comment: What full throttle adds to it

name: music_loops
comment: The music's loop points: each piece's name and the byte its loop starts at

name: sound3d_classes
comment: Each 3D voice's class

name: sound3d_engine_changed_at
comment: When the afterburner last came on or went off

name: sound_engine_voice
comment: The 3D voice of class player engines

name: sound_burner_voice
comment: The 3D voice of class player burners

name: sound_driver
comment: Miles's digital driver

name: music_level
comment: The music's level, 0 to 127, which fades

name: sound_buffered
comment: Each positional sound's level in the left ear and the right, gathered over a frame

name: volume_master
comment: Mastervolume, 0 to 127

name: volume_effects
comment: Fxvolume

name: volume_music
comment: Musicvolume

name: volume_speech
comment: Speechvolume

name: sound_settings_save
comment: Writes Fxvolume, Musicvolume, Speechvolume and Mastervolume to [Sound] of the settings file

name: armor_warned_at
comment: The frame_start the player's armour last warned at: object_armor_conditions warns no more than once in 500 ticks

name: shockwave_init
comment: Requires the ring textures rng_02, rng_03, rng_04, rng_01 and rng_06 into shockwave_textures, builds a ring over each into shockwave_meshes, and a sphere of 16 by 14 into shockwave_sphere, which nothing draws

name: shockwave_ring_mesh
comment: A ring over shockwave_textures[ring]: 8 points a unit out and 8 a tenth out about Z, 16 triangles between them, textured by how far each corner lies across and up either way, at least 1/64, coloured and added

name: sphere_mesh
type: void * __fastcall (int segments, int rings, float radius)
comment: A sphere of the radius, segments round and rings from pole to pole, textured by 0x00593798 with generated coordinates, coloured and added

name: shockwave_free
comment: Frees a shockwave's ring object and its slot

name: shockwave_deinit
comment: Frees every shockwave, the meshes and the sphere, and releases the textures

name: shockwaves_update
comment: Once a frame after explosions_update: each shockwave drifts by its velocity times frame_duration, its ring's colours fade from 1 to 0 over its life and it spreads to its size times how far through its life it is; as it passes the player kinds 0 to 2 raise hit_shake, 7 and 8 damage the player's quadrants through the shield reserves; 5 pushes and 6 damages other sides' ships; kind 7 is not drawn

name: shockwave_create
type: void __fastcall (Vec3 *at, float *orientation, Vec3 *velocity, int kind, float size, int life, char side, int owner)
comment: Sets a shockwave off into the first free of shockwaves (asserting shockwave count exceeded where none is): its kind's ring, never culled and coloured by its own colours, at scale 0

name: shockwaves
comment: Thirty shockwaves, 0x2C bytes each: kind, ring object, velocity a tick, size, birth, life, owner, side

name: shockwave_meshes
comment: The rings shockwave_ring_mesh builds, one over each of shockwave_textures

name: shockwave_textures
comment: rng_02, rng_03, rng_04, rng_01 and rng_06

name: shockwave_sphere
comment: The sphere shockwave_init builds, which nothing draws

name: debris_free
comment: Frees a debris record's object and its smoke emitter

name: SR_object_concate_parents
comment: An object's place in the world (+0x70, +0x4C) from its own (+0x3C, +0x18) and its parent's, the parents' first

name: scene_object_free
comment: Unlinks an object and frees it, and its mesh or its levels' meshes where flag 0x4000 says they are its own

name: sparks_init
comment: Builds the shape of each of the five spark kinds (spark_shape_build) and clears sparks

name: sparks_deinit
comment: Frees the spark shapes' meshes

name: sparks_reset
comment: Frees every spark

name: sparks_update
comment: Each spark past its kind's life is freed; the rest move on by velocity and carried velocity times the ticks since the last update, slow by the drag to the power of them, turn, grow or fade late by the kind's flags, and take the colour between the kind's first and last by how far through their life they are

name: spark_add
type: void __fastcall (int kind, Vec3 *at, Vec3 *carried, Vec3 *direction, float speed)
comment: A spark of the kind in the next of sparks, freeing what was there: its shape's levels, never culled and coloured by its own colours, looking along direction, at direction times speed a tick, drifting with carried

name: sparks_spray
type: void __fastcall (int kind, Vec3 *at, Vec3 *carried, Vec3 *direction, float speed, float spread, float speed_range, short count)
comment: count sparks along direction turned by a random pitch and yaw within half the spread either way, at speed and up to half the range either way; kinds 2 and 3 only within 20000 of the camera

name: spark_free
comment: Frees a spark's object and record

name: spark_shape_build
comment: Kind 0: a beam of three crossed quads over alhuge, drawn out to 1500000; the rest: two quads crossed along the length over lasers, out to the look's first distance, then one quad with generated coordinates out to its second

name: spark_looks
comment: Five spark kinds, 0x68 bytes each: half width, half height and length, two distances, texture name, texture span, first and last colour, life, drag, three flags

name: spark_next
comment: The slot of sparks the next spark takes

name: sparks_moved_at
comment: The frame_start the sparks last moved on at

name: sparks
comment: The sparks flying, 0x24 bytes each: kind, object, birth, velocity a tick, carried velocity a tick

name: spark_shapes
comment: Each spark kind's levels, 0x54 bytes each: count, distances, meshes

name: ai_target_node
comment: The node the AI aims at on a target: its component's node, the root's child 0x14 for types 0x43 and 0x49, 0x11 for 0x47, 0x13 for 0x48, else the root

name: ai_lead_aim
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *out, int slot, OrderEntry *entry, float lead)
comment: Picks the fastest of the guns the ship fires together (its group's two, or all) and leads the target with it (ai_lead_aim_with_gun)

name: ai_lead_aim_with_gun
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *out, void *node, OrderEntry *entry, int gun, float lead)
comment: Aims at the target's node, ahead along its heading by its speed times lead times the gun's flight time to it; false, leaving the node's place, when the flight takes a quarter of the gun's lifetime or more (three times the lifetime for the Turret Flak)

name: ai_along_nose
comment: Whether the point lies ahead of the frame and within radius of the line along its nose

name: ai_collision_course
type: bool __fastcall (int slot, int target, float steps, float margin, int *part, int *box)
comment: Whether the ship is on course to hit the target within steps: within reach at both cruise speeds with both radii and the margin; then, without components, the target ahead and the ship closing by its velocity less twice the target's to within both radii and the margin; with components, the ship's next position within its cruise times steps and the margin of a box of a part hanging from the root, whose part and box it hands back

name: maneuver_new_attack_run_start
comment: NewAttackRun's start: the way out, in the target's frame, from the firing arc of a component the target's model gives one (model +0x64), or from the part aimed at clear of the hull (ai_escape_direction); with its argument set, fighting to -1

name: ai_escape_direction
comment: The way clear of a ship hull from a point: each box of the collision trees of the parts on its root within 20000 of the point pushes away from it, harder the nearer; the sum normalized

name: player_control_entry
comment: The entry of the player's orders that is Player Control, which holds the player's target, or null for none

name: player_target_set
type: void __fastcall (short index, short component, int unused)
comment: Aims the player's Player Control order at an object and a component, then has the display follow it (hud_target_changed) and tells a multiplayer game (player_target_send)

name: player_target_cycle
type: bool __fastcall (short next, short among, int unused)
comment: Steps the player's target round the objects, the next where next is 1 and the previous otherwise, to one it can aim at, ejected ones included and cloaked friendly ones, not the player's: hostile within twice pick_range for among 1, friendly within it for 2, any for 0. None found leaves no target. The display follows either way. Returns whether one was found

name: player_subtarget_cycle
comment: Gives both forms of the target display their full time again, then for a target that lists components and is not friendly opens its form if shut and steps its component round to the next targetable one not hidden, or to none

name: player_target_send
comment: Sends the player's target to the other players in a multiplayer game, message 3

name: nav_point_next
comment: Takes as hud_object's nav point the first of the mission's nav points that the player's ship is still farther from than its reach, or none

name: hud_target_changed
comment: Follows a change of the player's target: copies it into hud_shown_target, points hud_target_object at it while it can be aimed at, and opens its form of the target display held, closing the other; with no target closes both

name: hud_target
comment: Draws the player's target in view 0. Off the screen or behind: an arrow from the middle, lines of palette 0x26 for a hostile target and 0x62 for the rest (0xB1 and 200 in software), none in the chase view, which shows chase_target_pointer instead; and a marker where a line its way leaves the screen, shapes 0x16C to 0x16F hostile or 0x170 to 0x173, with the range in font_small. On it: brackets 0x122, or 0x126 hostile, at the corners of its box as the camera sees it, dimmed by missile_lock_count; the range in font_new; and for a target that lists no components and is not friendly the lead cursor 0x12F at ai_lead_aim's point with a line toward the target, which sets hud_target_x and hud_target_y. Also marks the radio window's object (hud_comms_marker) and the nav point

name: hud_pointer_direction
comment: The unit way across and down to a target's node in hud_object's frame, turned a half round, and that way turned a quarter round more

name: hud_comms_marker
comment: While the radio's window is open or opening, draws shapes 0x12A to 0x12D at the corners of the box of the ship comms_object names, unless it is cloaked, where its middle is on the screen in front of the camera; the corners at least 15 apart either way

name: hud_missile_lock
comment: Runs the player's missile lock: its state at 0x0057DFF0 (0 idle, 1 closing, 2 waiting out the lock time, 3 locked, 5 lost), missile_lock_count and the ticks from minus the lock time, and places the three lock_rings on the line from the camera to the target node; in the chase view adds chase_target_pointer and chase_nav_pointer to the scene. Its building sound (0x0057DFC0) never plays, and it ends 2D voice 0 every frame

name: line_clip
comment: Clips a line to a pane in whole numbers, cutting an end outside back to the edge it crosses, then keeps both ends on the screen if any of the line is on the pane, which it counts at 0x005D60DC

name: fonts_open
comment: Once: builds the remap tables text is drawn through, text_colours and the side tables among them, and opens the fonts, font_small and font_new among them

name: hud_shown_target
comment: The player's target as the display has it, an order's entry of which only the target's index (0x005799EC) and component (0x005799EE) are set: hud_draw copies the Player Control order's target each frame, as hud_target_changed does

name: hud_target_object
comment: The object the display draws as the target, while the player can aim at it, a cloaked friendly one too outside a multiplayer game; null otherwise

name: hud_under_reticle
comment: The first object other than the player's within 0x20 of the middle of the screen either way, in front of the camera, which hud_target_keys finds and TARGET UNDER RETICULE takes; -1 for none

name: missile_lock_count
comment: The missile lock's count: 100 while no lock builds, down by the frame's ticks to 0 as one does, and back up as it is lost. hud_target draws the brackets at its hundredths of their brightness, none at a tenth or less, and shortens the lead cursor's line by 0.28 for each short of 100

name: pick_range
comment: 330000: the targeting keys reach twice as far from the player's ship

name: hud_lead_point
comment: Where hud_target's lead cursor aims, which the player's guns aim at while blind fire does

name: nav_point_count
comment: How many flyback markers the mission's script has set (SetFlybackMarker), ten at most; hud_init clears it

name: nav_points
comment: The flyback markers' objects, nav_point_count of them, -1 for one gone

name: nav_point_reaches
comment: How far the player's ship may stray from each flyback marker before nav_point_next points it back there: SetFlybackMarker's reach

name: chase_sight_near
comment: The chase view's near sight, a 600 square of chasetarget at full strength, which camera_chase stands 6000 ahead of the player's ship

name: chase_sight_far
comment: The chase view's far sight, a 600 square of chasetarget half grey, which camera_chase stands 12000 ahead of the player's ship

name: chase_blind_mark
comment: The chase view's mark of where blind fire aims, a 600 square, white, which hud_missile_lock stands 6000 from the ship toward hud_lead_point while blind fire aims

name: chase_pointer_roll
comment: The angle hud_target turns chase_target_pointer by about the ship's nose, less half a turn: the way to the target from straight up, going round to the right

name: hud_on
comment: While clear, hud_draw draws nothing and hud_missile_lock shows no chase view objects; hud_init sets it and nothing clears it

name: chase_target_pointer
comment: The chase view's pointer to the target, a scene object turned with the player's ship; bit 0 of its +0x14 hides it

name: chase_nav_pointer
comment: The chase view's pointer to the nav point, as chase_target_pointer

name: font_small
comment: smlfont.fnt, opened: the range by hud_target's marker at the screen's edge

name: font_new
comment: newfont.fnt, opened: the range by hud_target's brackets

name: text_colours
comment: The remap table most of the display's text is drawn through: each index itself, but 0, which is 0xFF

name: friendly_text_colours
comment: As text_colours, with 0xF7 as 0xD7: hud_target's range for a friendly target

name: hostile_text_colours
comment: As text_colours, with 0xF7 as 0x4C: hud_target's range for a hostile target

name: neutral_text_colours
comment: As text_colours: hud_target's range for a neutral target

name: ship_status_hits
comment: A flag for each quadrant of the player's ship whose armour a hit wore (object_armor_damage), which hud_ship_status flashes on the schematic as shapes 1 to 4 and clears

name: target_status_hits
comment: A flag for each quadrant of the target of the player's current order whose armour a hit wore (object_armor_damage), for the target display

name: primary_target
comment: The mission's primary target, the object's index then its component, -1 in both for none: SetPrimaryTarget sets it, PRIMARY TARGET makes it the player's, and mission_start clears it

name: sprite_block
comment: The address of block index of a loaded sprite set: its directory entry's offset from the set's start. hud_target hands palette_to_vfx the display's palette block this way

name: comms_menu_run
comment: Runs the radio's menu while its window is open, which hud_target_keys calls first: by the page at 0x00529530, sets the page's title string at 0x00529FB4 and runs its keys

name: comms_menu_draw
comment: The radio's menu in window 11, from x, y: COMMS in hud_font, then each item of the page from 0x18 below, 0xC apart, in font_new (comms_menu_draw_item)

name: comms_menu_draw_item
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, int index, int x, int y)
comment: An item of the radio's menu: its number and a full stop at x, y, and its words 0xD across, in font_new

name: comms_menu_add
comment: An item more on the radio menu's page: its words, the page it leads to and whom that page is about (wingman_addressed)

name: comms_menu_top
comment: The radio menu's top page, COMMS: Target for the player's hostile target that can be aimed at and is a fighter, a capital ship or one between; Alpha Wing where the player's wing has a ship not exploding; Base but in a scenario's map; Multiplayer in a network game

name: comms_menu_pilots
comment: The radio menu's Alpha Pilots: each ship of the player's wing but the player's, not exploding, as its pilot's name and its place's call sign, then Alpha Wing for more than one

name: comms_menu_base
comment: The radio menu's Base: Permission to land (but in a network game with 0x00588735 clear) and Request backup

name: comms_menu_channels
comment: The radio menu's Open channels, which no item leads to: Open all channels and Close all channels (kill_credit_on)

name: comms_menu_ship
comment: The radio menu's page for the ship wingman_addressed names, unless exploding: the five taunts for a hostile one; for one of the player's wing the commands, where the player's target is hostile, and What's your status?; then the scolding and the praise

name: comms_menu_wing
comment: The radio menu's Alpha Wing: the three wingmen's commands to a wingman the game picks

name: comms_taunt
comment: The radio menu's taunts (pages 6 to 10): the pilot says hud_007 to hud_011; a hostile fighter not to be disturbed otherwise, whose order has no priority and does not aim at the player already, turns on the player (Fight) and answers in 300 ticks, an ace in lines of its own

name: comms_status
comment: The radio menu's What's your status?: the pilot says hud_004, and a wingman with a pilot's face and a second value above 0 answers in 250 ticks by how whole its armour is

name: comms_scold
comment: The radio menu's Come on... get your act together: the pilot says hud_005, and the ship answers in 300 ticks, _cmon_ lines; to another player of a multiplayer game by 0x004983A0

name: comms_praise
comment: The radio menu's Nice work. I owe you one: the pilot says hud_006, and the ship answers in 300 ticks, _iou_ lines; to another player of a multiplayer game by 0x004983A0

name: comms_request_backup
comment: REQUEST BACKUP: the pilot says hud_013; while backup_available is set and backup_called clear, the player's ship's PlayerWantsBackup and backup_called set, and the carrier's bridge answers that backup comes, otherwise that it refuses

name: comms_menu_page
comment: The radio menu's page, -1 the top, which comms_menu_run makes and the number keys move on

name: comms_menu_items
comment: The radio menu's page's items, ten of 8 bytes: the words, the page each leads to and whom that page is about

name: comms_menu_count
comment: How many items the radio menu's page has

name: comms_menu_title
comment: The title each page of the radio's menu names, which nothing draws

name: backup_called
comment: Set as REQUEST BACKUP brings the mission's backup, so that only the first request does; radio_reset clears it

name: dm_scenario_mission
comment: Whether mission_number is the mission of one of dm_scenarios, which mission_start keeps as multiplayer_mission

name: dm_scenarios
comment: The multiplayer game's six scenarios, 0x40 bytes each, the first field the mission each is played in: 85, 82, 81, 83, 84 and 87

name: player_friend_destroyed
comment: Sets +0x678 of the player's ship to 1, or to 2 and sends it in a multiplayer game when told is 1: object_armor_damage and component_damage call it as the player's shot destroys a friend or a friend's component

name: friendly_fire_warning
comment: Outside a multiplayer game, adds the player's damage to a friend to 0x00562CEC; past 800 (0x004DC5EC), at most once every 3000 game ticks (0x00562CE8), Moose warns the player with one of ff_001 to ff_004, drawn with rand. Its count at 0x00562CF0 is held at 1, so the second and third sets of lines (ff_005 on, ff_009 on) never play

name: missile_lock_possible
comment: Whether the armed missile of the ring can lock on the target: one is armed, not of type 6, the target can be aimed at, the player's missiles are not disabled, outside a multiplayer game the target is hostile and the type not 0, and the target's node is within the type's range (+0x1C of its stats) and ahead of the ship

name: missile_lock_same
comment: Whether the lock building is still on the target, the component and the missile type it began on (0x0057E024, 0x0057E026, 0x0057DFB8)

name: hud_display_target
comment: The target the target display last drew, which hud_window_close draws the closing form's picture for and hud_subtarget picks out

name: hud_display_component
comment: The subtarget the target display last drew, -1 from window 3, which hud_window_close draws the closing form's picture for

name: hud_bar_pane
comment: A VFX pane the display cuts its bars into: the large target display's hull and subtarget armour bars, and the damage display's

name: hud_font
comment: blufont.fnt, opened (soft_blufont.fnt for the software renderer): the font of every line of the display's own text

name: mission_end_record
comment: As a single-player mission ends, unless the player's ship was destroyed or the pilot captured (mission_ending 1 or 3). A total failure (mission_success -1) sets mission_ending 5 and records nothing. Otherwise it keeps the rating in last_success, awards the mission's ribbon (ribbon_of_mission), promotes the pilot by skull_count against rank_kills, keeping the rank for the mission, and moves campaign_tier by mission_tiers. After mission 28 it moves mission_number to 29, the story's end, and stops. After any other it keeps the mission's rating, awards the mission's medal where it is rated a success with its bonus and the pilot was not picked up (medal_of_mission), playing its ceremony from the disc (medal_movies), moves mission_number on to the next, from 11 and 12 to 14, from 16 to 18 and from 21 to 23, saves the game (game_save, unless net_session), and copies the pilot's record into the profile (0x00562CF8: the mission, call sign, rank, tier, kills, medals, ribbons and each mission's rating and kills), which WinMain puts back before each single-player mission, and writes it (profile_save)

name: campaign_new
comment: A new campaign, which WinMain runs as the game starts, and the front end (0x00428C33, 0x00430AAF): clears the game's variables 0 to 31 and sets 5 to 8, 13, 14, 16 to 23, 29 to 32, 35 and 36 to 1; sets mission_number to 1, clears the pilot's tallies and each mission's records; then reads profile.bin (profile_load), or makes a new profile under the default name (string 0xBF) and writes it

name: profile_load
comment: Reads the 0xD0 bytes of profile.bin into 0x00562CF8 and copies the pilot's name from 0x00562CFC to 0x00562DCC

name: profile_save
comment: Writes the 0xD0 bytes at 0x00562CF8 to profile.bin

name: game_load
comment: Loads a saved game: reads the IFF file's SAVE form, each of its chunks MISS, VERS, VARS, PILO and ALPH into its place (0x00500A20), then clears the game's variables 0 to 31 and puts back those the game keeps from saved_variables

name: mission_reset_variables
comment: Before each attempt at a mission: clears the game's variables that belong to the attempt, 0, 1, 3, 9, 10, 37, 14, 28 and 34

name: game_save
comment: Saves the game as saves\<pilot>GAME<slot>.IFF: an IFF FORM of type SAVE holding a NAME chunk of name, then the chunks game_load reads, the game's variables it keeps first copied to saved_variables; false where saves\test.bin cannot be written in full

name: restart_save
comment: Saves the restart point, game_save of slot 100 named restart, which WinMain writes before a mission's attempts

name: restart_load
comment: Loads the restart point, saves\<pilot>game100.iff, for a replay or a restart, keeping the 42 bytes at 0x00562F18 as they were

name: saved_variables
comment: The VARS chunk of a saved game: the game's variables it keeps, in the order 16 to 21, 5, 22, 23, 6 to 8, 11 to 13, 24 to 27, 29 to 32, 34 and 36

name: rank_kills
comment: The kills each rank needs: 0, 35, 72, 115, 150, 200, 255, 275 and 300

name: skull_count_kept
comment: skull_count as the last mission the player came through left it, which WinMain puts back before each single-player mission

name: mission_kills
comment: The pilot's kills in each mission of the campaign, by mission_number, which kills_add counts for the local player

name: kill_credit_on
comment: While set, explode_kill_credit credits kills and has their radio lines said. A mission's start sets it (0x004560F0), and the radio menu's pages 20 and 21 set and clear it

name: mission_start
comment: A mission's start, the first of main.cpp's code: among much else it sets the rescue odds to always picked up and fits the player's ship with its devices and its cockpit

name: rescue_odds_rescued
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being picked up by a nanny ship, which order_eject draws from: 100 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' first argument

name: rescue_odds_captured
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being picked up by the enemy: 0 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' second argument

name: rescue_odds_killed
comment: The weight of an ejected pilot being killed: 0 from a mission's start, and SetRescueProbabilities' third argument

name: radar_contacts
comment: The radar's contacts, radar_contact_count of them, 20 bytes each: the dot's x and y and the height as ints, then whether hostile, the line's palette entry and whether the nav point as shorts

name: radar_contact_count
comment: The contacts in radar_contacts this frame

name: radar_reach
comment: How far each radar range reaches: 90000, 150000 and 230000

name: radar_scale
comment: The share of a unit of the world a radar pixel stands for at each range: a 150000th, a 230000th and a 330000th

name: comms_object
comment: The object the radio's window names, whose corners hud_comms_marker marks and whose radar contact shows in palette entry 0xFD with shape 0xE6

name: radio_name
comment: The string that names whoever says the line, which the radio's window shows over the face

name: radio_side
comment: The side of whoever says the line: the radio's window opens with shapes from 0x131 for a friendly one and from 0x148 for any other

name: radio_speech
comment: The speech file of the line the radio said last, read from speech_hog as it is said and started with its film

name: script_speech
comment: The speech file PlaySpeech plays

name: speech_heard
comment: Set as a line of speech first plays in a mission, when sound_volumes_apply sets the volumes again, alike either way; cleared by radio_reset

name: comms_movie_said
comment: Set by PlayCommsMovie; nothing reads it

name: radio_reset
comment: As hud_init readies a mission: empties the radio's queue and its delayed reports, names nobody in the window, clears the remarks' timers and flags, and the script's DisableGenericComms (0x00529538) and DisableTaunts (0x00529CB4)

name: SR_CCB_quantize_color
type: byte __thiscall (void *ccb, float red, float green, float blue)
comment: The palette entry of a colour table (CCB) nearest a colour of three levels from 0 to 1

name: explosion_spark
comment: Throws a small piece of debris into the next of explosion_bits, picked as explosion_bit picks one: at, flying at velocity a second, half to one and a half times size across, tumbling up to 0.05 a frame about each axis, for -100 to 300 ticks. particle_spark's, at size 0.1

name: mission_end
comment: A mission's end: among much else it frees the smoke's templates and pools (smoke_templates), the debris models, the radar's backing, the samples, the speech and the cockpit object, and ends the sounds and the music

name: smoke_start
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *object, ShpPart *part, int child, int attachment, int level)
comment: Starts an object's smoke again for level (smoke), from the engine glow attachment on part, the root's child: frees the old emitter, and for levels 1 to 3 hangs one from the child's frame where the attachment stands, turned as it is, its Z axis turned back where the attachment's length (+0x50) is negative, streaming along Z at 30 to 36 a tick, strayed 0.15 either way across at level 1 and 0.25 above, for 999999 ticks

name: smoke_template_create
comment: The smoke's template for level 1 to 3 and its pool of 1000: over gunflare\partic4, added, at 1 and 2, and gunflare\partic7, premultiplied, at 3, with sparks one time in 200; living 70 to 79 ticks at 1 and 100 to 109 above; mission_start makes the three into smoke_templates

name: smoke_templates
comment: The smoke's templates for levels 1 to 3 (smoke_template_create); smoke_start reads the level's from four bytes before, so level 0 reads paused_ticks, and makes no emitter for it

name: smoke_pool_light
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 1 (smoke_template_create); smoke_pool_heavy and smoke_pool_burning follow

name: smoke_pool_heavy
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 2

name: smoke_pool_burning
comment: The pool of the smoke's level 3

name: install_paths_read
comment: Reads the install's paths from HKLM Software\Microsoft\Microsoft Games\Starlancer\1.0: PID, InstallType, CDPath with game appended (cd_path) and InstallationDirectory with a backslash (install_directory). InstallType 3, a full install, sets full_install and both discs' folders to the installation directory. Without the key or either path, the current directory stands for all of them, as a full install

name: cd_in_drive
comment: Which disc is in the drive: 1 or 2 by which of cd1.bin and cd2.bin is in cd_path, or -1 for neither. In a full install cd_path is first set to the current disc's folder. Looks from cd_path and moves back into install_directory

name: cd_hog_open
comment: Opens the disc's cd%d.hog (cd_hog) from cd_path. In a full install cd_path is first set to that disc's folder; otherwise, with the other disc in the drive (cd_in_drive), it closes the hog and waits with an overlay (0x00430110) for the disc to be changed. Can't open HOG resource file is fatal

name: full_install
comment: Whether the hogs of both discs are read from folders of their own rather than the drive: an InstallType of 3, or no install in the registry (install_paths_read)

name: cd_current
comment: The disc whose hog is open, 1 or 2 (cd_hog_open)

name: cd_path
comment: Where the disc's hog is read from: the drive's game folder, or in a full install the current disc's folder

name: install_directory
comment: The installation directory, with a backslash, which the game works in

name: game_directory
comment: The game's directory, with a backslash, which starlancer.ini (settings_path) and default.txt (key_config_defaults) are read from

name: cd1_folder
comment: In a full install, where cd1.hog is: the installation directory

name: cd2_folder
comment: In a full install, where cd2.hog is: the installation directory

name: cd_hog
comment: The open disc's cd%d.hog (cd_hog_open)

name: menu_box_draw
type: void __fastcall (int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1)
comment: Outlines a rectangle on hud_pane in direct-colour reds: top and left 205, right and bottom 102.5, and a rectangle one pixel inside at 164. The pause menu frames its dialog and key lists with it

name: menu_mouse_update
comment: Moves menu_cursor_x and menu_cursor_y by the mouse, within the screen, puts the system cursor back near the window corner after a move, and sets menu_mouse_down, menu_mouse_pressed and menu_mouse_released from the left or right button

name: menu_draw
type: int __fastcall (int count, void *shapes, MenuItem *items, MenuString title, int mouse)
comment: Draws a pause menu title in optfnt over a red rule and count items of 0x30 bytes, each shape placed by screen fractions and offsets with its hover shape under the cursor, then each string white when highlighted, else orange; returns the item under the cursor or -1, testing none when mouse is 0

name: pause_screen_quit
comment: Pause screen 0, which nothing selects: four QUIT buttons going to screens 1, 6, 5 and 7; Escape goes to 6

name: pause_screen_debug
comment: Pause screen 8, which nothing reaches: lists the mission ships, sync states and globals on screen and appends them to c:\mission.txt every frame

name: pause_session_lost
comment: Pause screen 9 once mission_ending is 9: a dialog saying the session was terminated for a bad connection, whose OK leaves the mission as the button is released

name: pause_multiplayer_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 9: clears the scoreboard rows and lag flags, no player to drop, and makes menu_dialog_pane

name: pause_multiplayer_exit
comment: Leaving pause screen 9: destroys menu_dialog_pane

name: pause_screen_multiplayer
comment: Pause screen 9: PAUSED, LEAVE MISSION (7) and CONTINUE (6), the deathmatch scores with a drop button for each player lagging past 100, the message log, the chat line and who paused or why; Escape goes to 6

name: pause_screen_main
comment: Pause screen 1: SELECT AN OPTION, icons AUDIO (3), CONTROL DEVICES (2) and VIDEO (4), buttons LEAVE MISSION (7), RESTART (5) and CONTINUE (6); Escape goes to 6

name: pause_audio_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 3: keeps the four volumes for Cancel Changes and ends any drag

name: pause_screen_audio
comment: Pause screen 3, SOUND CONFIGURATION: speech, effects, music and master sliders 0 to 127 dragged by their knobs, a test sound as the effects knob is let go, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: pause_video_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 4: keeps cockpit_mode_setting and the brightness at sr + 0x15FA for Cancel Changes

name: pause_screen_video
comment: Pause screen 4, GRAPHICS CONFIGURATION: a BRIGHTNESS slider 0.5 to 2 while sr + 0x38 has bit 0, DEFAULT VIEW cycling cockpit, chase and no cockpit, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: video_settings_save
comment: Leaving pause screen 4: writes [Device] gamma, the brightness in hundredths, and [Device] View to the settings file

name: pause_controls_enter
comment: Entering pause screen 2: makes its three panes, reloads the bindings (key_config_defaults, load_key_config), numbers controls_list and keeps the settings and control_bindings for Cancel Changes

name: pause_controls_draw
comment: Draws pause screen 2: its items with the current check boxes and dimming, and the scrolled action and binding lists; returns the item under the cursor, 100 plus the action for a list row, or -1

name: pause_controls_conflict
comment: Pause screen 2's dialog for a key or button already bound: YES takes it from the other action, NO keeps waiting, as the button is released

name: pause_screen_controls
comment: Pause screen 2, CONTROL CONFIGURATION: controller and joystick settings, rebinding an action by clicking its row then pressing a key or joystick button, scrolling, OK (1), RESTART (5), CONTINUE (6), RESET DEFAULTS and CANCEL CHANGES; Escape goes to 1

name: pause_controls_exit
comment: Leaving pause screen 2: destroys its panes and calls save_key_config

name: pause_menu_open
comment: As the game pauses: opens optfnt.fnt and smlfnt2.fnt from resource.hog into menu_fonts, fills menu_text_remap, starts on screen 9 in a multiplayer session or 1 otherwise, and ends the missile lock tone

name: pause_menu_close
comment: As the game resumes: frees the two fonts pause_menu_open opened

name: pause_menu_draw
comment: The overlay in sr + 0x88 while paused, in place of hud_draw: runs the enter routine of a new pause_screen, the screen, the leave routine of the one left, then draws the cursor, shape 0x17E of hud_shapes

name: mission_paused_frame
comment: mission_run's work for each frame while paused: music, network, keyboard, joystick, menu_mouse_update and a render, then acts on pause_screen 5 (restart), 6 (resume) or 7 (leave, mission_ending 4); nonzero ends mission_run

name: hud_text_wrapped
type: int __fastcall (void *pane, int x, int y, void **font, char *text, byte *remap, int align, int width, int line_height, int max_lines)
comment: Draws text with hud_text in lines at most width wide, breaking at a line feed, a space, a hyphen, or mid-word with a hyphen added; returns the lines drawn

name: font_close
comment: Frees a font font_open made and the file it wraps

name: key_config_defaults
comment: Sets the input settings to their defaults and reads each binding from the KeyConfig section of default.txt in the installation directory

name: save_key_config
comment: Writes the input settings and every binding to the KeyConfig and JoyConfig sections of starlancer.ini

name: control_binding_find
type: int __fastcall (int except, int key, int modifier)
comment: The action other than except bound to a key with a modifier, or -1

name: net_send_pause
comment: Sends packet 0x27 to the other players: the pause flag and pause_reason

name: frame_timing_hold
comment: Stops (1) or restarts (0) the timing of the frame's current section, nesting

name: typed_keys_clear
comment: Empties the queue of typed characters at 0x005D547C

name: pause_screen
comment: The pause menu's screen: 1 main, 2 controls, 3 audio, 4 video, 9 multiplayer, 0 and 8 unreachable; 5, 6 and 7 are outcomes mission_paused_frame acts on: restart, resume, leave

name: pause_screen_entered
comment: The screen whose enter routine pause_menu_draw last ran; -1 as the pause opens

name: menu_cursor_x
comment: The pause menu cursor across in screen pixels: 320 at start, kept between pauses

name: menu_cursor_y
comment: The pause menu cursor down: 240 at start

name: menu_mouse_down
comment: Whether the left or right mouse button is down

name: menu_mouse_pressed
comment: Set in the paused frame a mouse button went down: what the pause screens act on

name: menu_mouse_released
comment: Set in the paused frame the buttons went up: what the pause dialogs act on

name: menu_text_remap
comment: The remap table pause menu text is drawn through: 0xFF for level 0 and each level 1 to 15 itself, which hud_palette_ramp colours

name: palette_ramp_brightness
comment: What hud_palette_ramp scales its ramp by: 1, or 0.5 for a dimmed item

name: menu_fonts
comment: The fonts a menu item picks by index: hud_font, smlfnt2.fnt, optfnt.fnt

name: menu_font_large
comment: optfnt.fnt, opened: titles and icon labels

name: menu_font_small
comment: smlfnt2.fnt, opened: buttons, lists and dialog text

name: menu_font_large_file
comment: optfnt.fnt as hog_load read it

name: menu_font_small_file
comment: smlfnt2.fnt as hog_load read it

name: controls_conflict_action

name: controls_conflict_key

name: controls_conflict_modifier

name: controls_conflict_key_name

name: controls_scroll_row

name: controls_scroll_direction
comment: -1, 0 or 1 as the list scrolls. Unknown: its reader

name: scoreboard_row_y

name: player_lagging

name: drop_player_of_item
comment: The player slot of each drop button

name: pause_reason
comment: Why a multiplayer game is paused: 0 a player paused it, 1 a bad connection; sent with the pause

name: pause_player
comment: The player who paused

name: chat_input
comment: The chat line being typed; game_pause empties it

name: chat_typing
comment: Set while a chat line is being typed

name: pause_view_setting
comment: cockpit_mode_setting as the game paused

name: paused_clock
comment: The clock mission_paused_frame measures frame_duration against

name: mission_restart
comment: Set for Restart: WinMain ends the mission and starts it again

name: missile_lock_tone
comment: The voice of the missile lock tone, stdsmp sound 0x15, held while a lock is complete in view 0; -1 for none

name: mission_loaded
comment: Set from the end of mission_start to mission_end

name: net_session
comment: Nonzero in a multiplayer session

name: window_suspended
comment: Set while the game's window is put away, from 0x004A8260 until input_init clears it; the message pump pauses the sound, and in a multiplayer session the mission, while it is set and the renderer runs. Unverified: what putting the window away is

name: window_suspend
comment: Unverified name: where the window is full-screen (0x004F634C), saves its style and placement, changes them and sets window_suspended; then acquires the input again

name: missiles_init
comment: Once, guarded by missiles_initialised: allocates missiles (200 of 0x28) and missile_trails (200 of 0x48), marks them free, fills missile_net_ids with -1, loads the stats (stats_load_missiles) and missiletrail\mtrail2

name: missiles_reset
comment: Frees every live missile's object and every trail's meshes as a mission ends, marks both pools free and empties missile_list and missile_trail_list

name: missiles_move
comment: The simulation step's move of each live missile, after objects_update: takes its next place, eases pitch and yaw rates toward input times turn rate by the rate inertias, turns by them, damps velocity by the inertia outside orders 0, 1 and 11, adds (1 - inertia) * throttle * max_speed along the nose, moves, and flags the root committed and unframed

name: missile_end
comment: Ends a missile: the voice its object holds, shockwave kind 5 for a Havoc and 6 for an Imp (50000 over 500 ticks, sparing the launcher's side), a remote id, missile_explode, detaches its trail, frees the object and the record

name: missile_hull_test
comment: The test object_hit_test calls for missile_hit_components: the missile's segment against a tree box, then at a leaf the faces through tree_leaf_segment_test, keeping the point, normal and node struck

name: missile_hit_components
comment: Tests a missile's segment against the collision trees of an object that lists components, at their next places; on a hit, but for a Havoc or an Imp, marks the node (effect 3) and gives its component component_damage, then ends the missile

name: missile_hit_hull
comment: A missile past an object's shields: where the segment meets the mesh box of a root child, but for a Havoc or an Imp, the quadrant's armour takes hull_damage and the part a mark (effect 2), and the missile ends. Returns 1 even when no box is met, leaving the missile undrawn for the frame

name: missile_collide
comment: A missile's contact this frame, its drawn place to its next: each object but the launcher, spheres for those without components (the shield by object_damage, the player's only as a fore hit empties a shield reserve; missile_hit_hull with the shield below 0), collision trees for the rest (missile_hit_components); a Havoc or an Imp just ends

name: missile_launch
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *launcher, int rack, int target, int component, int player, int net_id)
comment: Launches from a rack at +0x158: a new object of a pod's second model, or the hung object itself, at the hung node's world, next and drawn places; the launcher's velocity and side, the type's launch sound, one off the count, then order 0 and a trail from a pod, 1 and a trail from a rail, 11 for an emptied pod or a fuel pod; launches an emptied pod again to drop it

name: missile_launch_turret
type: void __fastcall (GameObject *ship, ModelNode *launcher, int unused, int target, int component, int unused2, int unused3)
comment: Launches a Screamer from a missile turret launcher node where the ship may launch missiles and a record is free: the Screamer pod second model, the ship side and velocity, placed at the launcher node world, next and frame places; its trail and the pod launch order; the target; no sound

name: missile_order_set
comment: Allocates the missile object's order stack and state on first use, runs the order's init from missile_orders, sets it, and runs its update once

name: missile_order_launch_init
comment: Init of missile orders 0 and 1: started becomes frame_start

name: missile_order_pod_launch
comment: Missile order 0: throttle 2 and no steering for 50 ticks, then the type's order

name: missile_order_rail_launch
comment: Missile order 1: no steering; throttle 0 with a push along its Y axis of 0.005 max_speed a tick for 25 ticks and back for 25, throttle 1 until 100, then the type's order

name: missile_fly_straight
comment: Throttle 1, no pitch or yaw

name: missile_home
comment: Guidance: the target node led along the target's nose by distance * speed / max_speed, or the decoy (caught within 1000); throttle by the cosine off the nose; pitch and yaw inputs from the angles less 4 times the rates, times 5.72958; a lost target, or one beyond 1000000, ends it, but a Solomon flies straight. A Vagabond may chase a cloaked target

name: missile_order_screamer
comment: Missile order 2: straight for a player's outside multiplayer, else missile_home

name: missile_order_proximity
comment: Missile orders 4 and 9 (Havoc, Imp): ends within 10000 of the target's root, else missile_home

name: missile_order_solomon
comment: Missile order 8: without a valid target, takes the nearest of another side within 0.7 of its nose, else the nearest, among objects without components, then among components; with none flies straight; then missile_home

name: missile_order_home
comment: Missile orders 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10: missile_home

name: missile_order_jettison_init
comment: Init of missile order 11: started becomes frame_start and the object is pushed 50 along its Y axis

name: missile_order_jettison
comment: Missile order 11: no thrust or steering, ending 100 ticks on

name: missile_explode
comment: A missile's blast: 50 sparkles of the sparkle template at a life spread of 200, a lit sheet fireball of 3 radii for 100 ticks, both drifting at a quarter of its velocity, and EXPLOSION01 at it among the explosions

name: tree_leaf_segment_test
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *from, Vec3 *to, void *leaf, Vec3 *point, Vec3 *normal, int *face)
comment: A segment in a part's frame against a collision tree leaf: its box, then each face the segment starts in front of by no more than its length, fanned into triangles (segment_meets_triangle); the last crossed wins

name: segment_meets_triangle
type: bool __fastcall (Vec3 *from, Vec3 *to, Vec3 *a, Vec3 *b, Vec3 *c, Vec3 *point)
comment: Where a segment crosses a triangle, solved through a 3x3 inverse for the share along it and across the edges from c

name: eray_add
type: void * __fastcall (int strands, int life, float jitter, float width, uint flags)
comment: Takes the first free of the 100 electric rays at 0x005531B0, freeing the first where all are taken, made by eray_create, with its life; order_disrupted_init plays fifteen, explode_part_burn one between each pair of points

name: eray_create
type: void * __fastcall (short strands, uint flags, float jitter, float width)
comment: An electric ray of 0x1B0 bytes (erayfx.cpp), lit, its time dark drawn up to 1500: 17 meshes a strand named Eray Mesh (eray_segment_mesh) and a light named Eray Light reaching 10000, hanging from the first strand middle segment

name: eray_segment_mesh
comment: A ray segment mesh: a square across its start over highlight texture 0, then two quads crossed along Z, 400 long, over laser2, lit and added by alpha

name: eray_jitter
comment: The point halfway between two of a strand 17 points, strayed at random by up to a share of their distance, then the same for each half, depth times

name: erays_init
comment: As a mission starts: laser2 into 0x005531AC, and the 100 ray slots emptied

name: erays_free
comment: Frees every electric ray

name: erays_update
comment: Once a frame (mission_frame): eray_update for each electric ray

name: eray_free
comment: Frees a ray segment objects, its light and the ray

name: eray_hang
comment: Hangs every segment of a ray from a frame, which its ends are in

name: eray_colour
comment: Colours a strand of a ray, and for the first strand its light

name: eray_update
comment: A ray frame: a timed one loses the ticks since it last moved and goes at none; one whose object stands in goes; a flickering one stays lit up to 100 ticks and dark up to 1500, dimming by 0.03 a tick if it fades; while bright each strand is jittered, its segments placed and stretched between its points, and drawn with the light

name: eray_texture
comment: laser2, which the electric rays are drawn over

name: erays
comment: The 100 electric rays

name: missiles
comment: 200 missile records of 0x28: started, object, launcher, decoy, trail, stats, net player, net id, older, newer

name: missile_list
comment: The newest live missile; they link to the older through +0x20

name: missile_orders
comment: The missile orders' init and update

name: missile_trail_create
type: void __fastcall (int *missile, int slot, int kind, int type)
comment: The first free trail, at the head of missile_trail_list: kind 1 follows the missile (and sets its +0x10), kind 2 an object slot; by missile_looks[type]'s pieces its side ribbons (black, at full strength), its ribbon, its plume and its glow, laid at the followed object's tail. Takes the record past the pool when every trail is taken

name: missile_trail_free
comment: Clears a trail's kind, frees its ribbons, plume and glow, and unlinks it

name: missile_trail_update
comment: The ribbon once a frame: fades each corner by frame_duration * 0.015 / (rings * 0.04); while following, lays the cursor ring at the tail at max(throttle, 0.5) times the look's colour, twisted or jittered by the look, hides the quads from it and shows those to it, and moves on 3 tail widths from the ring before; freed once faded with nothing to follow

name: missile_trail_mesh_create
comment: A ribbon mesh of rings of 4 corners, each joined to the next by two crossed quads and capped across the next, over missile_trail_texture, lit and added

name: missile_side_trails_update
comment: The side ribbons once a frame: fade; while following, the rings round the tail, a fifth of it and up to as much again, pushed out 0.5 to 0.8 of its half-width and turned by strand and by the turning; only the first moves the shared cursor. Once the last has faded, frees them, or the trail without a ribbon

name: missile_glow_create
comment: The glow: a set of 2 sprites named MissileTrail BMO over gunflare\partic6, lit and added

name: missile_glow_update
comment: The glow 50 behind a missile's or a Russian torpedo's tail, its first sprite as wide as the tail and up to a sixth more at random, its second half that

name: missile_plume_create
comment: The exhaust plume, Missilebursttrail mesh: 6 rings of 9 widening from nothing to 210 at 630 behind, over shield128, scaled by the alpha and added

name: missile_plume_colour
comment: Colours the plume's corners by nines from the first, 0.5 of the colour times brightness down to 0

name: missile_plume_update
comment: The plume at a missile's tail, its axis tilted up to 0.05 either way, coloured by the look, its texture turned by 0.091 a tick

name: missile_trails
comment: 200 trail records of 0x48: look, kind, missile, slot, cursors, ribbon, side ribbons, plume, glow, last scroll, next, previous

name: missile_trail_list
comment: The newest live trail; they link through +0x40

name: missile_trail_texture
comment: missiletrail\mtrail2

name: missile_looks
comment: Each missile type's trail: its pieces, its ribbon's rings and colour, its side ribbons' and its plume's colour

name: decoys_init
comment: Clears countermeasures, loads ships\decoy.shp into decoy_model and makes decoy_particles: life 100 and up to 10 more, rate 50, size 50 to 100, grey from 0.25 to nothing

name: countermeasure_end
comment: Ends a countermeasure: every missile chasing it turns back to its target, and it ends in a sheet fireball of 200 over 50 ticks, drifting at its velocity

name: decoys_free
comment: Frees every countermeasure and decoy_particles

name: decoys_update
comment: Once a frame after explosions_update: each countermeasure past its time ends; the rest turn about their Y axis by 0.01 for each tick and one more, drift by their velocity times the ticks, and stream their smoke

name: countermeasures
comment: Countermeasures in flight: live, until, owner slot, velocity, scene object and two emitters

name: decoy_model
comment: ships\decoy.shp

name: decoy_particles
comment: The countermeasures' smoke

name: hud_beep_sounds
comment: hud_beep's sample of bank_stdsmp and volume for each sound: 15 to 20, at 60

name: hud_missile_armed
comment: The armed entry of hud_missile_ring, at six o'clock

name: player_missiles_left
comment: The ring's counts summed; nothing reads it

name: missile_empty_warned_at
comment: game_ticks until which Betty says no more that the armed missile has run out as a launch is refused

name: hud_missile_ring_build
comment: Builds hud_missile_ring from the player's racks: an entry a type but the fuel pod, counts summed, the middle entry armed and the places round it

name: player_launch_missile
comment: LAUNCH MISSILE: nothing with missiles disabled or jumping; the Kamov lets its launched craft go; types 1 to 5, 7 and 8 need the lock (else stdsmp 1 and, with none left, betty 0 at most once in 500 ticks); cloaked outside multiplayer drops the cloak; opens window 2 held; launches from the first rack of the armed type with a missile, at the target while locked; counts one off the ring

name: missile_lock_state
comment: The player's lock: 0 idle, 1 closing, 2 waiting out the lock time, 3 locked, 5 lost

name: missile_lock_ticks
comment: From minus the armed type's lock time up while the lock builds and holds; down as it is lost

name: missile_lock_turn
comment: The ticks past the lock a lost lock kept, which turn the rings in degrees

name: missile_lock_type
comment: The missile type the lock began on

name: missile_lock_entry
comment: The player's Player Control entry, refreshed each frame

name: missile_lock_point
comment: Where the lock rings close in on: the target node while the lock holds

name: missile_lock_build_voice
comment: The voice meant for the lock's building sound; starts 0, never -1, so the sound never plays

name: lock_rings
comment: The lock's three ring objects over lock_ring_mesh

name: lock_ring_mesh
comment: A square 256 across over tarring

name: lock_ring_mesh_create
comment: Makes lock_ring_mesh: one quad of 4 corners at 128 either way over tarring, its own coordinates, lit and added

name: lock_rings_init
comment: Makes lock_rings, each over a quarter of tarring, and sets missile_lock_state to 0

name: player_missile_guiding
comment: Whether a live missile the player launched still has a target

name: camera_missile
comment: The missile record the missile view (0x12) follows

name: camera_missile_gone
comment: Set once the missile the missile view follows has ended

name: object_loadout_by_tier
comment: Rack types for each missile attachment (kind 0) of the root's child parts: the attachment's id for the tier (+0x34 + 4 * tier); the player's ship in simulator mode 1 or missions 30 to 35 gets 5, 3, 1 in turn

name: object_fit_missiles
comment: Hangs each rack's pod or missile (attachment_models kind 0, the second model in multiplayer) on the missile attachments of the root's child parts, its count from the model table; a type below 0 leaves count 0 and stops the fitting there; fatal past 20

name: lock_rings_free
comment: Frees the lock rings and their mesh

name: radio_missile_warning
comment: While a missile homes on the player's ship in action, at most every 1000 ticks of frame_start (0x005297E4), Moose says one of plck_001 to plck_008 unless the radio is busy or 0x00529538 is set, dropped after 500

name: launch_torpedo_run
comment: A torpedo's launch: at step 2 it lets go of its tube, heard (sound 0x18), boosting at throttle 2 by motion_plain from the carrier's velocity with a torpedo's trail; 200 ticks on it flies itself, its order popped, targetable and colliding again, Launched posted

name: camera_set_view_call
type: void __fastcall (int view, int object, bool force, bool unknown)
comment: Calls camera_set_view

name: missiles_free
comment: Frees the missile and trail pools and clears missiles_initialised

name: missile_lock_target
comment: The target and component the lock began on, at +4 and +6, laid out as an order entry for ai_target_node

name: missile_lock_unused
comment: Counted in lock states 2, 3 and 5, capped at 90; never read

name: lock_ring_angles
comment: Each lock ring's own turn this frame

name: enemy_lock_voice
comment: stdsmp sound 0 on voice 1, played again while the enemy lock light shows; -1 for none

name: campaign_tier
comment: The tier fighters asked for tier 0 take in single player: 0, then 1 after mission 11, 2 after 19, 3 after 21

name: missile_net_ids
comment: In a network game, each remote player's missile id to a local record, -1 for none

name: player_loadouts
comment: The loadout screen's choice for each player slot, 0x54 bytes: the ship, then 20 rack types, -1 for none

name: skip_briefing
comment: Set when a mission starts without its briefing and loadout; the player's ship then takes the tier's loadout

name: missile_name_voice
comment: The voice Betty last said the armed missile's name on, as ROTATE MISSILES turns the ring; ended before the next

name: missile_name_until
comment: game_ticks + 150 as Betty says a missile's name; nothing reads it

name: object_hull_lost
comment: Ends a ship that lists components as its hull is destroyed: its order gives way as to Explode, its stack is emptied, it is marked exploding, and Destroyed is queued for it (event_destroyed)

name: explode_capship_component
comment: The routine create_object gives most capital ships, bases and stations at +0x614, by the type whose stats they take: for a destroyed part of class hull, marks the ship unpowered and exploding, hides its force fields, splits it in two by its record (0x0046F480; clip planes, a shockwave, bursts), credits a Kurgan, Antanov or Gurevich to the player, ends it (object_hull_lost) and returns false; true for any other part

name: explode_ulysses_component
comment: Type 0x16 routine at +0x614: marks the ship unpowered; Ulysses Top throws off an object of type 0x4B and ends the ship, Ulysses Fin one of type 0x4C with fireballs and sound 0x41; returns false

name: explode_component_lost
comment: What the destruction of a component of assembly link sets off: first a few types extras (0x44, 0x45, 0x47, 0x48, 0x6D, 0x78, 0xA8), then each part of the assembly going up (explode_part_burst) by their radii together, 200 of the flame and sound 0xB at the root

name: explode_part_burst
comment: A part going up as its component is destroyed: a lit fireball its size, a burning bit at every third of 20 points within 0.3 of its radius, and its mesh cut in four through the ship (model_slice), each quarter again in two, four, eight and two, flying off at their cuts times reach over 60 with the ship velocity, a hundredth of both a tick, for 100 to 119 ticks, toward a lit fireball where each ends; then the node children

name: node_forget
comment: For a node being destroyed and those hanging from it: a turret base sets the turret kind of each of its owner guns whose base it is to -1; a part node leaves its owner components and the table at +0x518

name: node_free
comment: Frees a node, after the nodes hanging from it in its holder's child list: a part's scene object at +0x0C, its capital shield and its frame; kind 3's sprites; kind 6's hit effect; any other's frame; then its children

name: hud_subtarget_clear
comment: Puts back the meshes hud_subtarget copied to pick the player subtarget out in red

name: split_slot_free
comment: The first empty slot of the splits under way (0x0055335C), or 0 when all ten are taken

name: split_create
comment: Starts a capital ship splitting in two: a 0x44-byte record in a slot of 0x0055335C with split_update and split_free, the tick, its sequence (explode_sequence_find), two portals of flag 0x100, the root position, engines_disabled, the Krasnaya arms and the Boridin breakaway core taken apart, and the points of each root child point list of kind 2 in the root frame (split_point_insert)

name: split_point_insert
comment: Adds a point to a split list, in ascending z where sorted, else at the end; one that belongs right after the head goes before it

name: split_points_free
comment: Frees a split point list

name: split_point_nth
comment: The nth point of a split list, the head for n of 0 or less, or null past the end

name: split_free
comment: Frees a split portals, its point list and the record, and clears its slot

name: split_update
comment: Runs a split once a frame: mode 0 sweeps a cut through the points with fireballs, bits and sounds, the portals in the scene and the ship held shaking, then parts the halves; mode 1 bursts about the ship, then shows the wreck; always true, freeing itself at the end

name: explode_sequence_find
comment: The index of a type record in the explosion sequences (0x004FFB50, 40 of 0x2C bytes), or -1

name: explode_flash_near
comment: Flashes the screen for 100 ticks (0x00587CC8) where the camera stands within 5 radii of the object

name: screen_flash_draw
comment: Once a frame (mission_frame): while flash_ticks lasts, the flash sprite white at 0.012 a tick left, at most 1, counting it down by frame_duration; in view 0 the red of hud_interference instead; drawn on layer 2 under a hardware renderer; then hud_interference_fade

name: flash_ticks
comment: How many ticks the screen flash has left: 100 when a capital ship comes apart near the camera

name: flash_sprite
comment: The sprite over the whole view that the screen flash and the red of a hit show on, untextured and added, made as a mission starts

name: ulysses_split_update
comment: The Ulysses split frame: fireballs and burning bits along its top, at 0.1 bodies; at 900 ticks its end, the flash near it, and its halves burning

name: explode_part_burn
type: void __fastcall (int slot, char *name, bool forever, bool flickers, bool no_lights)
comment: Sets a wreck part burning: an electric ray between each pair of its kind 1 points but the last, fading, flickering if asked, for 5000 ticks unless forever; then unless no_lights its burn lights (part_burn_lights) and smoke (part_streams)

name: part_burn_lights
comment: A red Burn light at the first point of each kind 4 point list of the part, in 15 slots at 0x0055AD24

name: part_streams
comment: A particle stream at each point of the part kind 3 point lists, along its vertex normal, for 5000 ticks or for good, into 0x0055AD60

name: burn_light_free
comment: Frees a burn light slot and its light

name: burn_lights
comment: 15 burning wrecks lights, 8 bytes each: the light, and what is left of it, fading by 0.0001 a tick and flickering between half and full

name: burn_streams
comment: 64 burning wrecks smoke emitters, which explosions_update streams each frame

name: wreck_smoke_template
comment: The particle template a burning wreck streams: grey puffs 50 to 150 across over about a second

name: big_smoke_template
comment: The particle template of great grey puffs 1000 to 2500 across, which the Boridin breakaway streams

name: krasnaya_left_arm_off
comment: Throws the Krasnaya left arm off as an object of type 0xA3 and shows its wreck parts, with fireballs and a flash

name: krasnaya_right_arm_off
comment: Throws the Krasnaya right arm off as an object of type 0xA3 and shows its wreck parts, with fireballs and a flash

name: node_tree_stop
comment: Sets the animation speed of a node and all under it to 0

name: eray_remove
comment: Frees an electric ray wherever it is in the 100 slots

name: node_point_group
comment: The point list of a kind on the node part, or null

name: node_find_named

comment: Clears the portal of a node and all under it, leaving frame flag 2 set

comment: Turns a beam hanging from the ship's hull (Nanny or Antanov) to the pod, and stretches its ribbons' far corners to reach it

name: exhaust_ship_count

name: launches_free

comment: Turns the camera to look at the player's ship

name: objectives_reset
comment: Every mission's first objective current, each other with a name listed

comment: Set while the display types out the mission's date, from the drop of the player's launch to its end

name: launch_caption_due
comment: The game's tick after which the date shows a letter more

name: launch_caption_shown
comment: How many letters of the date show

comment: The language string of each mission's date, which the launch types out: 0 for mission 0, then missions 1 to 28

name: wait_still_moving
comment: Set by WaitForJumpOrLaunch's walk where a ship still jumps, warps or launches

name: escort_marker_free
comment: Frees the escort point's marker as the mission ends

name: escort_marker_frame

comment: The ticks the escort point's marker pulses by, 0 to 299

name: escort_marker_mesh

name: escort_marker
comment: The escort point's marker's scene object

name: curve_axis
comment: One component of curve_point

name: hermite_to

name: hermite_arriving
comment: t^3 - t^2, the weight of a curve's arriving tangent, turned about

name: curve_starting_at

name: curve_next

name: curve_length

name: curve_rebuild

name: curve_init
comment: A curve from one point to another that names no ships, with no tangents

name: curve_ride

name: curve_index
comment: Index of a curve record

comment: The four Hermite weights at each 32nd of the way, 33 sets (curve_weights_fill)

name: director_yaw

name: director_pitch

name: director_curve
comment: The curve the director's camera flies along

name: director_tracked
comment: The ship the director's camera looks at, or null

name: director_elapsed

comment: Where the ship the director's path rides along with stood as the shot began

name: director_pace
comment: The ship the director's path rides along with, or null

name: director_next_marker

name: director_still
comment: The ship the director's camera stands at in a shot with no curve

name: camera_shot_count
comment: How many of the director's shots wait

name: camera_shot_hold_kind
comment: The kind of what the first shot holds still: 0 a ship, 1 a flight group, 2 a squad

name: camera_shot_hold_index
comment: The index of what the first shot holds still

name: camera_held_index
comment: The index of what the shot on screen holds still

name: dock_styles
comment: Dock's five styles: init, update, exit, 0, name and 0 each

name: rippercargo

name: next_rippercargo

name: planet_atmosphere_texture

name: planets_turned_at

name: land_yamato_cutaway
