comment: Whether the pilot is female, which the pilot roster sets: the pilot's own lines are fp's rather than mp's

name: permission_to_land
comment: PERMISSION TO LAND, from frame_controls and the radio's menu with remote 0: heard once in 500 ticks, the pilot asks (pilot_says hud_012) and in 300 ticks the training's instructor clears the player's ship where landing_cleared is set, or the carrier's bridge answers (bridge_line), clearing it by a line mission_success picks or refusing it; a cleared ship lands on its carrier. With remote set, the bridge clears the ship whatever the script says (Land)

name: permission_heard_from
comment: The game_ticks from which PERMISSION TO LAND is heard again

name: landing_cleared
comment: Script variable 10: whether PERMISSION TO LAND clears the player's ship to land

name: mission_success
comment: Script variable 14: how the script rates the mission, -1 a total failure to 4 a success with a bonus, which picks the carrier's clearance

name: backup_available
comment: Script variable 3: whether the carrier sends backup; the radio's REQUEST BACKUP (0x004558D0) raises PlayerWantsBackup for the first request while it is set, and the carrier refuses otherwise

name: last_success
comment: Script variable 27: mission_end_record's copy of mission_success as a mission the player comes through ends with a rating other than a total failure; mission 25's second part weighs its own rating by it

name: objectives_met
comment: Script variable 28: set by the script once the mission's objectives are met; the debriefing of a mission the ejected pilot was picked up in picks string 0x720 by it, and 0x721 without it (0x00424ECE, 0x0042545B)

name: ghost_alive
comment: Script variable 30: whether mission 1's Ghost lives, 1 in a new campaign; mission 1's script clears it as Ghost dies and mission 4's reads it

name: countdown
comment: Script variable 33: seconds left, which mission 29's script sets; game_tick takes one off at every 100th of mission_ticks (0x00477889) and the display shows it as a clock in mission 29 (0x00486221)

name: ion_cannons_hold_lock
comment: Script variable 37: while it is set, the Dark Reign's ion cannon (aiioncan.cpp, order 110) keeps its target rather than losing it or giving up its search (0x0040D40F, 0x0040D7D9)

name: friendly_fire_send_home
comment: Outside a multiplayer game, for the player's ship while mission_ending is 0 and its current order has no priority: the mission's ending 6, or 7 where +0x678 is 3, Friendly Fire pushed aimed as the current order, and flag 0x10000000 set; for another player's slot without a prioritised order, Jump Out and the flag

name: voice_init
comment: Starts decoding a speech stream (voice.zig): the bit reader on its first byte, the header's step, coded levels, first gain and ratio, and the coefficients, the filter's memory and the past excitation cleared

name: voice_read_bits
comment: The stream's next bits, eight at most, least significant first, taking the next byte below eight held

name: voice_frame
comment: Decodes a frame of 432 samples: twelve coefficient levels, then each subframe's lag, pitch gain, gain and pulses into the excitation, the last 324 kept, and the synthesis filter over four blocks as the coefficients step

name: voice_pulses
type: void __fastcall (VoiceState *state, int coded, float *excitation, int step)
comment: A subframe's pulses at a step: the plain code, or the variable code of two contexts with pulses, runs of zeros and escapes

name: voice_skip_bits
comment: The stream past its next bits, eight at most

name: voice_fill
comment: Fills in every other sample of an excitation read at a step of two, from six neighbours weighted 0.5974, -0.1146 and 0.0180

name: voice_synthesize
comment: Filters blocks of twelve of the frame's samples into speech, each the sample plus the filter's weights times the twelve before

name: voice_coefficients
comment: The synthesis filter's twelve weights from the twelve reflection coefficients, the lattice's impulse response

name: voice_bit_masks
comment: The masks voice_read_bits reads n bits by

name: voice_levels
comment: The levels a reflection coefficient is quantized to; the last eight coefficients take the 32 from the 17th

name: voice_symbols
comment: For each of the pulse code's two contexts, the symbol the stream's next eight bits begin with

name: voice_records
comment: The pulse code's 29 symbols: the next context, the length in bits and the value, three dwords each

name: speech_start
type: int __fastcall (SpeechHeader *file, uint flags, int rate, int volume, int slot)
comment: Plays a speech file on stream slot: unscrambled, its decoder started, and the speech sample set up as 16-bit stereo at 22050 Hz at Speechvolume times Mastervolume / 127; flags bit 0 loops it; the stream's own volume, volume / 127, is kept but applied nowhere

name: speech_unscramble
comment: XORs the stream from +0xC with AB 2D 9A AA repeating, length - 0x18 bytes, unless the file begins man or CB, and writes man over its length; the files are scrambled to 8 bytes before their end, so the last 8 scrambled bytes are left

name: speech_stop
comment: Ends the stream in slot, 0 to 7, by clearing its state

name: speech_playing
comment: Whether the stream in slot plays, or -1 for a slot past the eight

name: speech_stop_all
comment: Ends every stream and the speech sample

name: speech_restart
comment: Starts a stream's decoder again from its data, its frame spent

name: speech_init
comment: Once: the streams cleared, the speech timer started and its buffer of 0x4000 bytes allocated (cbox.cpp)

name: speech_timer
comment: The timer's callback: the first stream playing decodes 2048 frames into the speech sample's next buffer, each float rounded and held to 16 bits, and a stream over is ended

name: speech_fetch
comment: Fills out with the stream's next samples as floats plus 12582912, each for both channels, decoding a frame as one runs out; 1 once the stream's samples are done, or looping it where its flag says

name: speech_streams
comment: Eight speech streams of 0xD64 bytes: the data, the sample count, a rate, the volume over 127, the loop flag, the state at +0x14, the decoder at +0x18, the frame's sample at +0xD5C and the samples played at +0xD60

name: speech_sample
comment: The Miles sample the speech plays on, which sound_init allocates

name: speech_buffers
comment: The speech sample's double buffer

name: radio_say
type: void __fastcall (char *film, char *speech, int mode, short name, HudmovieFlags flags, int object, int expiry)
comment: Says a line outside a multiplayer mission: mode 0 at once, window 0 opened held unless it is open, the speech stopped, the speaker's name, object and side kept for the window, the speech read and the film played; 1 queued; 2 queued unless the radio is busy; a full queue drops it

name: radio_say_ship
type: void __fastcall (int slot, int head, char *speech, int mode, HudmovieFlags flags, int expiry)
comment: radio_say for the ship in slot, unless a stand-in, exploding or without a pilot record, with the film its record names for the head movement

name: radio_busy
comment: Whether a line plays or waits in the queue

name: radio_frame
comment: Each frame: while lines wait, the window is shut or open and no speech plays, the next line is taken and said unless its time has passed

name: radio_queue
comment: The radio's five queued lines, 0x74 bytes each: the film's flags, the speaker's name, the film, the speech, whose it is and the tick it expires at

name: radio_queue_count
comment: How many lines wait in radio_queue

name: radio_queue_write
comment: Where the next line queued goes

name: radio_queue_read
comment: Where the next line said comes from

name: pilot_faces
comment: The pilots' faces, one for each pilot of pilot_stats, which object_set_pilot points an object at as pilot_record: the string that names the pilot, a halfword 0x53, the side, a halfword, and the films of its face for the four head movements, talking, laughing, the 45th's own pilot and dying

name: talkie_unpack_vectors
type: void __fastcall (int *out, byte *packed, int count, int bits)
comment: Unpacks count numbers of bits each from packed, least significant bit first, sign-extending from the top bit: a delta frame's motion vectors, 10 bits a part (talkie.zig)

name: talkie_patterns
comment: Draws count blocks of four colours, 8 bytes each, four palette entries and two bits a pixel from the last, into 16 pixels each

name: talkie_frame
comment: Decodes a chunk of a face film, fLED a delta frame and fYEK a key frame, frees it, and returns the frame decoded

name: talkie_delta
comment: A delta frame: the frames swapped, the vectors, whole blocks, patterns and map unpacked, and the frame assembled from the one before (blocks_assemble)

name: talkie_key
comment: A key frame: the size and palette read, the see-through colour found and the palette converted for the display, the frames and tables made, and the pixels expanded with RefPack

name: talkie_state_new
comment: A face film's decoder, 0x544 bytes cleared

name: talkie_state_free
comment: Frees a decoder and its frames and tables

name: talkie_read_chunk
comment: Reads the next chunk of a face film from the archive's stream, 8 bytes of header and its size, unscrambled; null at fDNE or the end

name: talkie_unscramble
comment: XORs a chunk with A3 27 B7 DD repeating, from its header's end up to 8 bytes before its end

name: blocks_assemble
type: void __cdecl (uint *map, byte *previous, byte *next, int vectors, int *offsets, byte *blocks, int width, int across, int down)
comment: Assembles a frame of 4 by 4 blocks from its map: an entry below vectors copies the block from the frame before moved by its offset, any other a block given, the entry less vectors

name: blocks_unpack_map
type: void __cdecl (uint *out, byte *packed, int count, int bits)
comment: Unpacks count entries of bits each from packed, least significant bit first: a delta frame's block map

name: read_le_bytes
comment: The first count bytes as a little-endian number

name: hudmovie_init
comment: Once: the face film's decoder, its timer at 15 a second, and pilots.hog opened, which is fatal to fail

name: hudmovie_shutdown
comment: Ends the film's timer, frees its frame and decoder, and closes pilots.hog

name: hudmovie_play
comment: Plays a face film by name from pilots.hog, the 45th Volunteers' films up to mission 13 and the 45th Tigers' from mission 14 on, its first chunk decoded into the window's frame. With a film playing already, the speech starts at once unless flags bit 3; otherwise it waits for the window (hudmovie_waiting). Bit 0 loops the film, bit 1 holds it while the speech plays, bit 2 takes its palette. Fatal where pilots.hog lacks the film

name: hudmovie_stop
comment: Stops the film and frees its frame and decoder

name: hudmovie_timer
comment: The film's timer, 15 a second: the next chunk decoded and copied into the window's frame; at the end, the film looped or, holding for the speech, static.fm8 played once the speech is over

name: hudmovie_state
comment: The face film's decoder

name: hudmovie_file
comment: pilots.hog's stream, at the film's chunks

name: hudmovie_start
comment: Where the film's chunks begin in pilots.hog, to loop back to

name: hudmovie_frame_count
comment: How many frames the film has shown

name: hudmovie_width
comment: The film's width

name: hudmovie_height
comment: The film's height

name: hudmovie_frame
comment: The frame decoded last, 4 bytes of size then the pixels

name: hudmovie_frame_new
comment: Set as a frame is decoded and cleared as the radio's window draws it; nothing reads it

name: hudmovie_playing
comment: Whether a film plays

name: hudmovie_waiting
comment: Set while the line said with the film waits for the radio's window to open: the timer holds the film, and hud_draw starts the speech once hudmovie_waited passes 0x5B

name: hudmovie_waited
comment: The ticks the line has waited for the radio's window, which hud_draw counts and the window shows as a shape from 0x131, or 0x148 for a speaker not friendly, on by one each 4

name: hudmovie_chunk
comment: The film's chunk read last

name: hudmovie_flags
comment: The film's flags as hudmovie_play took them

name: pilots_hog
comment: pilots.hog, opened by hudmovie_init

name: hudmovie_image
comment: The window's copy of the frame, width by height pixels

name: hudmovie_timer_handle
comment: The film's timer

name: hudmovie_static
comment: pilots\static.fm8, the film of a dead channel, played once a line's film is over and the speech goes on

name: ship_line
comment: The name of the line ending in suffix that the pilot of the ship in slot says, written into 0x00529CC0: for a friendly ship in the voice allied_voices gives its pilot, for a hostile one in rus, chn or arb by its pilot face's +0x06; null for a pilot with none. Any other side's leaves the buffer as it was

name: allied_voices
comment: ship_line's case for each pilot up to 0xB9 flying a friendly ship: the voice its lines start with, 0 ban, 1 dic, 2 fre, 3 vip, 4 enq, 5 sil, 6 tak, 7 jor, 8 vix, 9 cut, 10 cla, 11 ski, 12 jui, 13 fac, 14 haw, 15 arr, 16 ner, 17 rhi, 18 sta, 19 fla, 20 wor, 21 ego, 22 none

name: radio_landing_reminder
comment: Each frame, unless the player's ship is landing: while landing_cleared is set and mission_ending 0, the reminder runs (0x00529878). As it begins, in training the flight instructor says trnprm_001; otherwise every 4500 ticks of frame_start (0x00529D40) Moose says moolnd_001 to 003 unless 0x00529538 is set

name: radio_jump_reminder
comment: Each frame: while jump_ready or warp_ready is set and mission_ending 0, the reminder runs (0x00529874). As it begins, the flight instructor in training says trnjmp_001, Moose otherwise jmp_001 to 004 or wrp_001 to 004. Outside training Moose then calls every 2000 game ticks (0x00529D44), moo_w1001 to moo_w4004, counted at 0x00529598, and 300 ticks after the fourth call player_jump

name: radio_rescue
comment: Each frame, once frame_start passes 0x00529880 after a wingman's pilot ejected (0x00529590): unless the pod explodes or 0x00529538 is set, the pilot of player_wing[5] says res_001 to 003 in its voice (ship_line) unless the radio is busy; 0x00529590 goes back to -1

name: radio_remarks_frame
comment: Each frame after radio_reports_frame: radio_landing_reminder, radio_jump_reminder, radio_missile_warning and radio_rescue

name: radio_enemy_taunt
comment: As the ship in slot hits the player's ship with damage of kind 0, 1 or 5: a hostile ship not listing components, at most once in 2000 ticks of frame_start (0x005297EC), says tnt_001 to 013 in its voice (ship_line) unless the radio is busy, 0x00529538 or 0x00529CB4 is set

name: radio_launch_line
comment: As the player's launch goes, unless 0x00529538 is set and while the radio is free: the flight instructor says trnlch_001 in training, and otherwise the Reliant's bridge officer (pilot 0x3C) relbdg_001 to 006 or the Yamato's (0x54) yambdg_001 to 005

name: landing_reminded
comment: Whether radio_landing_reminder has begun

name: landing_reminder_next
comment: The frame_start past which radio_landing_reminder next speaks

name: jump_reminded
comment: Whether radio_jump_reminder has begun

name: jump_calls
comment: How many of Moose's calls to jump radio_jump_reminder has made

name: jump_call_next
comment: The game tick from which radio_jump_reminder makes its next call

name: missile_warning_next
comment: The frame_start past which radio_missile_warning may speak again

name: ejected_wingman
comment: The slot of the pod of the wingman who ejected last, until radio_rescue; -1 for none

name: rescue_at
comment: The frame_start past which radio_rescue says the rescue's words

name: kill_remark_next
comment: The game tick past which a kill draws radio_kill_remark's remark again

name: taunt_next
comment: The frame_start past which radio_enemy_taunt may taunt again

name: radio_line_buffer
comment: Where ship_line, bridge_line and pilot_line write the lines they name

name: generic_comms_disabled
comment: The script's DisableGenericComms: set, the radio's remarks but the jump reminder's are left unsaid; radio_reset clears it

name: taunts_disabled
comment: The script's DisableTaunts: set, radio_enemy_taunt says nothing; radio_reset clears it

name: objectives_none_shown
comment: Set where OBJECTIVES WINDOW paged through every objective and found each hidden, for the objectives window to say No current objectives. (string 0x54A); mission_start clears it

name: objectives_no_name
comment: ERROR: No mission Objectives defined!, which the objectives window shows for an objective with no name or a mission past the table

name: attack_standing
comment: How the wingman in slot stands to ATTACK MY TARGET: 1 busy (flag DoNotDisturb, or its current order has a priority), 2 its current order aimed at the player's target already, 0 free

name: wingmen_attack_my_target
comment: ATTACK MY TARGET to the wingman 0x00529596 names, or -1 for one picked the likelier the farther from the player: the pilot says hud_001; a free wingman fights the player's target (Fight) and answers _amt_ in its voice as a report 300 ticks on; one busy or on it already only answers. -2 and -3 send it over a multiplayer game

name: back_off_standing
comment: How the wingman in slot stands to BACK OFF: 1 flag DoNotDisturb, 0 its current order Fight aimed at the player's target, 2 otherwise

name: wingmen_back_off
comment: BACK OFF to the wingman 0x00529596 names, or -1 for one picked at random: the pilot says hud_002; a wingman fighting the player's target pops the order and sets it aside for 3000 game ticks (+0x6AC, +0x6B0), and answers _bkoff_ in its voice as a report

name: help_standing
comment: How the wingman in slot stands to HELP ME: 1 busy (flag DoNotDisturb, or its current order has a priority), 2 its current order Fight aimed at one of the attackers, 0 free

name: wingmen_help_me
comment: HELP ME to the wingman 0x00529596 names, or -1 for one picked the likelier the farther from the player: the pilot says hud_003; the attackers are the hostile ships whose Fight aims at the player, or else the player's hostile target; a free wingman fights one at random and answers _hlpme_ in its voice as a report

name: pilot_full_replies
comment: Whether the pilot of the ship in slot answers the wingmen's commands from the fuller set of replies: by 0x004539D0 for pilots up to 0x78, Bandit, Diceman, Viper, Enriquez and Hawkeye

name: full_replies_cases
comment: pilot_full_replies's case for each pilot up to 0x78: 0 for the fuller set of replies, 1 for the other

name: wingman_addressed
comment: Who the wingmen's commands go to: -1 a wingman the game picks, -2 and -3 another player of a multiplayer game, or the slot the radio's menu names

name: simulator
comment: Set while the front end runs mission 29 as its simulator: mission_start then gives the wing no pilots, and the wingmen's keys go unheard

name: friendly_fire_reset
comment: Clears friendly_fire_warning's damage, count and quiet tick, as mission_run starts a mission

name: order_friendly_fire_init
comment: The init of order 117, Friendly Fire: stage 0 for 300 ticks; Moose says one of ff_013 to ff_023, or where +0x678 is 2 or 3 the carrier aborts, abrt_001 by pilot 27 for the Reliant and 28 otherwise

name: order_friendly_fire
comment: Order 117, Friendly Fire: stage 0 the player flies on; stage 1 for 700 ticks ai_steer toward player_carrier mixed 0.3 with the player's controls 0.7, throttle 0.7 of the player's; stage 2 pops it, clears flag 0x10000000, clears the carrier's flag 0x20, pushes Land on the carrier and Jump Out beyond 1000000 of it, and sets the flag again. In a multiplayer game, Jump Out alone

name: friendly_fire_damage
comment: The player's damage to friends since friendly_fire_warning last warned

name: friendly_fire_count
comment: The warnings friendly_fire_warning has given, held at 1

name: friendly_fire_quiet_until
comment: The game tick up to which friendly_fire_warning gives no warning

name: friendly_fire_warnings
comment: Moose's warnings of the player's hits on friends, a set of four for each count: ff_001 to ff_012

name: friendly_fire_home_lines
comment: Moose's words as the player is sent home, ff_013 to ff_023

name: interface_palette_ramp
comment: The front end's copy of hud_palette_ramp: entries 1 to 15 of VFX's global palette, or on an 8-bit pane interface_text_remap, a ramp of rgb at palette_ramp_brightness, which its text is drawn through. The main menu writes in 0x40BCFF, gold 0xFDB951 under the pointer, and the developers' text in 0xFF0000

name: interface_init
comment: The front end's start-up: reads bank_stdsmp (stdsmp.fat), opens handel.fnt, interface\optfnt.fnt and interface\smlfnt2.fnt (interface_font_handel, interface_font_large, interface_font_small), and makes interface_text_remap

name: interface_run
comment: The front end: runs the screen of interface_screen, from screen, each until it returns nonzero, the render hook 0x0043E730 between them. Returns 1 to fly without the briefing, 2 to fly, 3 to quit, 4 or 5 to set the display up again

name: main_menu
comment: Front end screen 0 over interface\sl_splash2.tga, with interface\frontend.spr (interface_shapes): SINGLE PLAYER to screen 12, MULTI PLAYER to 14, GAME OPTIONS to 1, QUIT, which asks (interface_confirm) and returns 3, and INSTANT ACTION, which flies mission 29 in ship 2 as the simulator until it is left. POTATO typed with Control turns on developer_mode: then the number keys type mission_number, Shift or Control with Enter flies it from its briefing, and Shift with F1 to F12 without, in ship 0 to 11

name: main_menu_draw
comment: The main menu's render hook: the panels' labels in interface_font_large, QUIT and INSTANT ACTION in interface_font_small, their buttons, the item under the pointer lit (main_menu_hotspots) with a panel's labels in gold, the dialogs, the pointer's shape, and with developer_mode M and mission_number in font_01

name: interface_pointer_update
comment: Moves interface_pointer_x and interface_pointer_y by the mouse, within the screen, runs interface_pointer_ticks on by the ticks since it last ran, back to 0 at 64, and reads the buttons (interface_pointer_down, interface_pointer_right_down)

name: interface_confirm
comment: The front end's YES or NO dialog, with quit.spr (dialog_shapes): asks language_string(message), or dialog_text for -1, until Escape, which answers NO, or a click on a button (dialog_buttons), answered once the button comes up; true for YES

name: interface_confirm_draw
comment: Draws interface_confirm's dialog while dialog_open: the box, the buttons with the one under the pointer lit (dialog_button), the question 400 wide in lines 14 apart, and YES and NO

name: interface_message_draw
comment: Draws the front end's message dialog while 0x0051D7D8 is set: the box, the message, language_string(0x005202D0), 400 wide in lines 16 apart, and OK

name: interface_hit
type: int __fastcall (short *rects, int count, int x, int y)
comment: The first of count rectangles of four shorts, corner and size, that holds x, y with the edges left out, or -1

name: background_load
comment: Reads background_name as a TGA and hands it to the device (sr + 0x50), or runs background_hook where one is set; with no name, clears the picture

name: background_set
comment: Shows the picture of name behind the frames, loading it (background_load) unless background_name is it already, case aside; null clears it. The front end's screens and loading_screen set one

name: loading_screen
comment: The first frame of mission_load's loading screen: LOADING written as loading_line, which no overlay draws, and interface\sl_splash.tga, sl_splash800.tga or sl_splash1024.tga, by the screen's width, rendered alone

name: interface_screen
comment: The front end's screen, which interface_run runs: 0 main menu, 1 GAME OPTIONS, 3 audio, 7 briefing, 8 the landing movie, 10 and 11 the multiplayer sessions, 12 pilot roster, 13 saved games, 14 connection, 15 video, 16 controls, 17 and 18 a session's loadout

name: interface_pointer_x
comment: The front end's pointer across (interface_pointer_update), 320 as the main menu starts

name: interface_pointer_y
comment: The front end's pointer down, 200 as the main menu starts

name: interface_pointer_down
comment: Whether the front end's pointer's left button is down, which chooses what is under it

name: interface_pointer_right_down
comment: Whether the front end's pointer's right button is down

name: interface_pointer_ticks
comment: The ticks into the pointer's animation: shape 1 + ticks / 4 of the screen's set, 16 of them

name: main_menu_item
comment: The main menu's item under the pointer (main_menu_hotspots), or -1

name: interface_shapes
comment: The shown screen's shapes, which each screen reads as it starts and frees as it leaves: the main menu's interface\frontend.spr, the pointer's 16 shapes, the lit panels and the buttons; the pilot roster's interface\frntend2.spr

name: main_menu_hotspots
comment: The main menu's items: corner, size, what choosing returns (3 for QUIT) and the lit shape; SINGLE PLAYER, MULTI PLAYER, GAME OPTIONS, QUIT and INSTANT ACTION

name: developer_mode
comment: Set by the main menu's POTATO, typed with Control, until the game quits: the developers' keys and the mission's number shown

name: dialog_message
comment: The string id interface_confirm asks, or -1 for dialog_text

name: dialog_shapes
comment: quit.spr while interface_confirm's dialog is up

name: dialog_button
comment: The dialog's button under the pointer: 0 YES, 1 NO, -1 none; in SET GAME DIFFICULTY (difficulty_dialog), 0 START, 1 BACK, 2 and 3 the arrows down and up; its low byte is also interface_text_remap's entry for level 16, -1 and so clear while no dialog's button is under the pointer

name: dialog_buttons
comment: interface_confirm's YES and NO: corner and size

name: interface_font_large
comment: interface\optfnt.fnt, opened by interface_init: the main menu's labels and the dialogs

name: interface_font_small
comment: interface\smlfnt2.fnt, opened by interface_init

name: interface_font_handel
comment: handel.fnt, opened by interface_init

name: interface_text_remap
comment: The remap table the front end's text is drawn through: 0xFF for level 0 and each level 1 to 15 itself, which interface_palette_ramp colours; level 16, which a few glyphs use in their first column, reads the low byte of dialog_button after it

name: font_01
comment: font_01.fnt, opened with the display's fonts: the main menu's developers' text

name: background_name
comment: The name of the picture shown behind the frames (background_set)

name: background_hook
comment: A routine background_load runs in place of loading background_name, where set

name: wgate_tunnel_colours
comment: A tunnel's colours by ring: black and clear at the mouth and the last ring, the deep colour on the ring before the last, and between them from the mouth's colour to the middle's in a straight line over 0.3 of the rings, then to the end's by the square root; blue, or red for kind 2; a software renderer's white to black

name: wgate_wipe_level
comment: cosine_ease from from down to 0, at clamped to 0 to 1: how bright a collapsing tunnel's wipe leaves a vertex

name: wgate_tunnel_build
comment: A tunnel's mesh object (Wgate_Mesh): rings of segments by the detail round a centre vertex, a gate's 80 times 1.2 to the 8 less the ring times its size across, a warp's 344 or so; two triangles a segment between rings, warp128 added with a highlight by the normals in a second pass but for the last band, coordinates a unit along for eight rings, flattened, and wgate_tunnel_colours

name: wgates_init
comment: The gates' start with each attempt: the tunnels' segments and rings by the detail, their textures (warp128 or ddwarp128, laser2 or ddlaserr), the flags cleared, the warps' two particle templates, and the records cleared

name: wgates_free
comment: The gates' end with a mission: the particle templates, every record, the warps' beams and emitters, and the Boridin's object let go

name: wgate_tunnel_shape
comment: Each vertex of a record's tunnel at its ring's radius round the axis and at its ring's depth, the last ring at the one before's; at the high detail each sways across and down by up to 41.7 (a gate) or 5.83 times the segments

name: wgate_portal_set_up
comment: A record's portal hangs from its tunnel, faces along the axis, and stands at ring rings - 5 as the tunnel stands now

name: wgate_create
comment: Takes the first free of the 32 records for a tunnel of a kind at an object: a gate's hangs from the object's frame at at, turned a half turn about Y, with two flash squares (warpin3) and its rings' depths; a warp's stands at the object with four beams and emitters; the portal made. -1 where all are taken

name: wgate_free
comment: Lets a record go, with what its kind made

name: wgate_find
comment: The first record whose tunnel stands at an object, or -1

name: wgate_tunnel_scroll
comment: A tunnel's hook as it is drawn: scrolls its texture 3.5 across and 0.6 along for each thousandth of a tick since it last did, the first time only noting the tick

name: wgates_frame
comment: Each frame, from shield_bubbles_draw, for each record of a gate: its rings' depths sway by its time, its tunnel is shaped and its normals and bounds follow, its portal goes into the scene, and its tunnel too unless the player's ship rides the worm

name: wgate_tunnel_fade
comment: A collapsing gate's tunnel fading: at of its vertices, counted from the centre, take a pale grey, the ring before the last green

name: wgate_tunnel_burn
comment: A collapsing gate's tunnel burning out: a share of its vertices flickering by sin(at times 1000), counted from the centre, take a dull red, the ring before the last blue

name: wgate_tunnel_dent
comment: A ship dents the tunnel of its record as it passes; the list at +0x80 it is run for is never filled

name: node_tree_second_passes
comment: Turns the second pass on or off of each group with a second texture of the meshes of a node and every node under it

name: worm_create
comment: The worm the player's ship rides between gates (Worm_Mesh): 31 rings of 16 segments 10000 across and 200000 apart, drawn solid with warp128 and a highlight added by its normals, coloured by worm_colours

name: worm_wobble
comment: Each vertex of the worm sways across and down by up to 2000 about its place round the tube, at its own pace by the frame's tick

name: worm_colours
comment: The worm's colours by ring, as a proto gate's tunnel's over 31 rings

name: wgate_warp_sizes
comment: The entry of wgate_warp_size_table for an object's type, or -1

name: node_tree_show_light_sprites
comment: Hides the light sprites (node kind 3) of a node and every node under it, or shows them again

name: environment_effects_create
comment: From backdrop_create: the effects cleared, Planet Bombard's flashes and the ice field built

name: environment_effects_free
comment: From backdrop_free: Planet Bombard's flashes and the ice field let go

name: environment_effects_clear
comment: Every effect off and asked for none, and the objects' flag changes asked for at the next jump dropped

name: environment_effects_frame
comment: From backdrop_frame: the ice field while it is on, then environment_effect_2

name: ice_field_create
comment: The ice field's rocks, 200, 500 or 800 by the detail, each a farast2 triangle showing one of five pictures, a grey of its own, 2500 from the camera in one of two bands and two arcs, a size and a turn rate of its own

name: ice_field_free
comment: Lets the ice field's rocks and their mesh go

name: ice_field_frame
comment: While the ice field is on, each rock within about 49 degrees of the camera's axis stands at its place from the camera, facing it and turned by its rate, in the background layer

name: ice_rock_mesh
comment: The ice field's triangle: its point at its place, its base a unit up, drawn with farast2 by the coordinates each rock gives it, lit, and blended by the rock's colours

name: bombard_flashes_create
comment: Planet Bombard's ten flashes (Boom_Mesh, pbang), 25000 across one time in ten and 3000 to 18000 otherwise, which nothing draws

name: bombard_flashes_frame
comment: Planet Bombard's flashes' frame, which nothing calls

name: environment_effect_2
comment: Whether effect 2 is on, which nothing reads

name: wgate_records
comment: The gates' records (wgate_create, 0x88 bytes each)

name: wgate_mask
comment: A bit for each record in use

name: wgate_segments
comment: The tunnels' segments round, by the detail

name: wgate_rings
comment: The tunnels' rings along, by the detail

name: wgate_segment_step
comment: One over wgate_segments

name: wgate_ring_step
comment: One over wgate_rings

name: wgate_texture
comment: The tunnels' texture: warp128, or ddwarp128 without a hardware renderer

name: wgate_exiting
comment: Set while a ship goes out through a tunnel, which the next Fixed Gate Jump Out waits for

name: wgate_riding
comment: Set while the player's ship rides the worm, which leaves the gates' tunnels out of the scene

name: worm
comment: The worm the player's ship rides, made anew for each of its jumps out

name: wgate_spread
comment: Where the next ship comes out of Fixed Gate Jump In, turned 0.3 about the tunnel's axis a step, from -2 to 2; -2 at the start

name: ice_rock_count
comment: The ice field's rocks: 200, 500 or 800 by the detail

name: ice_rocks
comment: The ice field's rocks' mesh objects

name: ice_rock_offsets
comment: From the camera to each of the ice field's rocks, 2500 long

name: ice_rock_spins
comment: How fast each of the ice field's rocks turns, in radians a tick

name: ice_texture
comment: The ice field's texture, farast2

name: ice_mesh
comment: The ice field's triangle (ice_rock_mesh)

name: ice_rock_pictures
comment: The five pictures of rocks in farast2, three texture coordinates each

name: environment_effects_on
comment: The environment effects on, a bit each

name: environment_effects_asked
comment: The environment effects asked for, which environment_update turns on and off

name: environment_effects_ready
comment: The effects environment_effect_set takes: 0 and 2

name: mission_terminated
comment: How many times the script has ended the mission (TerminateMission): mission_run zeroes it and ends its loop once it is set, and a mission below 28 then ends as the player's ship's destruction does

name: simulator_mode
comment: The game's mode: 0 none, PREPARING FOR LAUNCH; 1 the Reliant's simulator's training, Calibrating Simulator; 2 Instant Action, Preparing for Instant Action

name: loading_line_draw
comment: The loading screens' overlay (sr + 0x88): loading_line in hud_font_large (optfnt.fnt) through the last of text_ramps, centred across and its top 40 pixels above the screen's foot

name: loading_players_draw
comment: mission_load's overlay: loading_line_draw's line, then in a network session each player's name down the left, 18 pixels apart, and READY (string 0x145) 0x165 across beside each one ready, or beside all where 0x005D5E7C is set

name: loading_step
comment: Before each of renderer_load's loads after the first: the message pump, LOADING (string 0x32A) as loading_line, loading_line_draw as the overlay, and a frame rendered and flipped

name: renderer_load
comment: The loading renderer_start ends with: VFX's palette made of the renderer's, LOADING as loading_line and interface\splash.tga behind a frame rendered alone, then the ships' stats, particles_init, backdrop_create, nebula_create, attachment_models_load, engine_glows_build, guns_init, missiles_init, shieldfx_init with shields_init, eject_init, ai_first_setup and the pilots' stats, a loading_step before each but the first

name: loading_line
comment: The line the loading screens write under their picture (loading_line_draw)

name: text_ramps
comment: Sixteen remap tables of a font's coverage levels, which fonts_open builds: level c of table k to 255 less 63 k c / 225 of the renderer's palette under a hardware renderer, the greys at the top of palette.tga, and to 31 k c / 225 under the software one; level 0 clear (0xFF). The loading screens draw through the last

name: hud_font_large
comment: optfnt.fnt, opened by fonts_open: the loading screens' line

name: pilot_roster
comment: Front end screen 12 over interface\main2sin.tga with interface\frntend2.spr (interface_shapes): the pilot male or female (pilot_female), the call sign (call_sign) typed in pilot_roster_draw or picked from callsign_list, Enter or a click off the call sign ending its typing (the profile's name, profile_save, callsign_add); START GAME asks the difficulty (difficulty_dialog), then campaign_new and returns 1; LOAD GAME leads to screen 13, MAIN MENU and Escape to screen 0, and QUIT asks (interface_confirm) and ends the game (game_exit)

name: pilot_roster_draw
comment: The pilot roster's render hook: the pilot chosen lit, the labels in blue, the call sign's frame (interface_box) and the call sign, white while it is typed a character a frame (text_entry_step) with its cursor, the buttons with the one under the pointer lit and its label white, the list of call signs where it is open, SET GAME DIFFICULTY or QUIT's dialog where either is up, and the pointer

name: difficulty_dialog
comment: SET GAME DIFFICULTY over the pilot roster (difficulty_dialog_open): sets difficulty to 1, then its arrows step it down and up, going round, until START (1), or BACK or Escape (0); a press acts once, until the button comes up

name: callsign_add
comment: Puts call_sign in callsign_list unless it is there: in the first empty place, or, the list full, in the last, the rest moved up a place and the first let go; then callsigns_save

name: callsigns_load
comment: Reads callsign_list from starlancer.ini's CallsignList section, name00 to name09, the first PLAYER (string 0xBF) where there is none, counting the places (callsign_count)

name: callsigns_save
comment: Writes callsign_list to starlancer.ini's CallsignList section as name00 to name09, then reads it back (callsigns_load)

name: text_entry_set_up
type: void __fastcall (void *pane, int unused, char *buffer, int size, int length, void **font, byte *remap)
comment: Sets up the line text_entry_step types into: its pane, its buffer and size, its length, and the font and remap it is measured and drawn with

name: text_entry_step
comment: Takes the next typed character (typed_key_pop) into the line text_entry_set_up set up: a backspace takes the last character off; another goes on the end, and is taken back off where the line grows max_width wide in font, or with no font as long as its size less one. Returns the character

name: typed_key_pop
comment: The first character queued at typed_keys, taken off, or 0 for none

name: interface_box
type: void __fastcall (int x, int y, int width, int height, float brightness)
comment: Frames a box on the front end's screen: its top and left edges in 0x00A7FF, its right and bottom in 0x005785, each a pixel short of the corner the other starts from, and a second frame a pixel inside in 0x0086CD

name: window_proc
type: int __stdcall (void *window, uint message, uint wparam, int lparam)
comment: The game window's procedure: among the rest, queues WM_CHAR's characters at typed_keys, a hundred at most, refusing file_name_refused's while typed_file_name is set

name: game_exit
comment: Ends the game, as QUIT on the pilot roster answered YES does: shuts the texture cache, the input, the sound, the music and the rest down, and exits

name: campaign_pilots_reset
comment: Sets the campaign's pilots afresh as the pilot roster starts a new campaign: every fourth byte from 0x005047D2 to 2, and the player's wing's pilots at 0x0058A958 to -1, 0x55, 0x6C, 0x56, 0xAC and 7

name: callsign_list
comment: The call signs of the last ten pilots, which starlancer.ini keeps (callsigns_load, callsigns_save) and the pilot roster lists

name: callsign_count
comment: How many of callsign_list's places callsigns_load read: always 10, an empty one counting too

name: call_sign
comment: The pilot's call sign, which the pilot roster types or picks and profile_load gives from the profile's name; the saved games are named by it

name: typed_keys
comment: The characters typed into the game's window, which window_proc queues from WM_CHAR and typed_key_pop takes off

name: typed_key_count
comment: How many characters typed_keys holds

name: file_name_refused
comment: The characters a file's name can't hold, which window_proc refuses while typed_file_name is set

name: typed_file_name
comment: Set while the text typed names a file, as the pilot roster's call sign names the saved games: window_proc refuses file_name_refused's characters

name: roster_typing
comment: Whether the pilot roster's call sign is typed

name: roster_cursor_shown
comment: Whether the call sign's cursor shows while it is typed, which turns on or off once 25 ticks have passed (roster_cursor_blink)

name: roster_cursor_blink
comment: The timer's tick after which the call sign's cursor next turns on or off

name: roster_list_open
comment: Whether the pilot roster's list of call signs is open

name: roster_item
comment: The pilot roster's item under the pointer, -1 for none: the male pilot, the female pilot, LOAD GAME, START GAME, MAIN MENU, the call sign, QUIT, the list's arrow

name: difficulty_dialog_open
comment: Set while SET GAME DIFFICULTY is up over the pilot roster (difficulty_dialog)

name: roster_female
comment: Whether the roster's pilot is female, which the pilot roster and the saved games set with pilot_female; nothing reads it

name: profile
comment: The pilot's profile, profile.bin: the pilot's name at 0x00562CFC, 32 bytes, then the rank, the medals and the tallies from 0x00562D1C

name: profile_name
comment: profile.bin, the pilot's profile in the game's folder

name: splash_to_menu_play
comment: As WinMain opens the front end, unless launched by a lobby: plays splash to mm.bik (play_bink_movie_no_clear), the splash turning into the main menu, then puts 0x005D54E8 in bink_copy_extra; returns 1

name: play_bink_movie_no_clear
comment: Plays a movie in a loop of its own at 15 frames a second (BinkSetFrameRate, BINKFRAMERATE), its sound through Miles, over what the screen shows: each pass the message pump, the keyboard and the pointer, then bink_frame once BinkWait lets it, until Escape, the pointer's right button, the movie's end (bink_ended) or the game quitting; nothing where the transitions are off (sr + 0x15F8)

name: play_bink_movie
comment: Plays a movie as play_bink_movie_no_clear does, at its own rate and full volume (BinkSetVolume 0x8000), on a screen bink_frame clears to black first (bink_clear); nothing where the transitions are off on a renderer that is not a hardware one. renderer_load plays the intro with it

name: play_bink_movie_no_clear_resourced
comment: Plays a movie as play_bink_movie_no_clear does, found in the disc's archive (cd_hog, hog_locate) and opened where it lies (BinkOpen with BINKFILEHANDLE), but at the movie's own rate: it sets 15 frames a second without BINKFRAMERATE. A chapter's end plays its movie and the news with it

name: play_bink_movie_resourced
comment: Plays a movie as play_bink_movie does, found in the disc's archive (cd_hog, hog_locate) and opened where it lies (BinkOpen with BINKFILEHANDLE). The hangar's movies and a chapter's zoom play with it

name: hangar_movie_play
comment: Before each mission WinMain flies, unless a lobby launched the game: opens the mission's disc (cd_hog_open, 1 past mission 18, else 2) and plays the next of three hangar movies (hangar_movie_last) with play_bink_movie_resourced: y_h_ta.bik to y_h_tc.bik past mission 18, else r_h_ta.bik to r_h_tc.bik

name: play_landing_movie
comment: As the pilot comes back from a mission WinMain flew: nothing after mission 25's second part or mission 27 with variable 36 clear, nor for mission_ending 6 and 7. Where the mission ends a chapter (chapter_of_mission) and is not rated -1, the chapter's end: the zoom, the chapter's movie with newsloop.fat's loop, and the news the game's variables call for. Otherwise the landing, r_h_land.bik or yamland_generic.bik from the disc at 15 frames a second, then the thread's movie from the game's folder, opened in memory (landing_thread_bink), under the first sound of the land bank; the thread and the bank by the rating

name: ending_movies_play
comment: The story's end, once mission_end_record moves the pilot past mission 28: new_chapter6_thread1.bik (play_bink_movie_resourced), the news by variables 8, 7 and 13, each after acntran.bik, then acntran.bik and new_chapter6.bik (play_bink_movie_no_clear_resourced), then the credits (0x004AC780)

name: landing_movie_screen
comment: Screen 8 of interface_run: after a second's wait, play_landing_movie; returns 3. No code found selects it

name: pickup_count
comment: Counts a pickup of the ejected pilot by a nanny ship (0x00562ED4): 1 once there have been more than two, which WinMain follows with a transfer's movie; else 0, the count kept for the mission (0x00562E9A)

name: bink_frame
comment: A movie's frame due: decoded (BinkDoFrame), copied into the middle of the screen (BinkCopyToBuffer), the screen wiped black first where bink_clear is set; then the next frame next (BinkNextFrame), or the movie marked ended at its last (bink_ended)

name: bink_movie
comment: The movie a player plays, play_landing_movie's landing too (HBINK)

name: bink_playing
comment: The movie playing, which the message pump pauses while the window is away (BinkPause); the briefing's too

name: bink_ended
comment: Set by bink_frame as a movie's last frame shows, which ends its loop

name: bink_clear
comment: Set by play_bink_movie, play_bink_movie_resourced and play_landing_movie for bink_frame to wipe the screen black before the first frame

name: bink_looping
comment: Set while a movie's loop runs: the players' (play_bink_movie and the rest) and play_landing_movie's

name: game_quitting
comment: Set as the game is to quit, which ends a movie's loop and then the game (game_exit)

name: bink_copy_flags
comment: The surface type the movies are copied in (BinkCopyToBuffer): 3 for a screen whose green is 0x3E0, 4 otherwise

name: bink_copy_extra
comment: Flags added to bink_copy_flags as a frame is copied (BinkCopyToBuffer), which the front end's screens set

name: transitions
comment: Whether the movies between the front end's screens play: [Device] Transitions, 1 unless set (0x004A9081), which the front end's video options write

name: intro_played
comment: Counts the renderer's starts that played the intro: renderer_load plays it while this is 0

name: hangar_movie_last
comment: The hangar's movie played last, 0 to 2, which hangar_movie_play steps on before each; WinMain sets it to 0 as it opens the front end (0x004A9587)

name: landing_thread_bink
comment: The thread's movie play_landing_movie plays after the landing, opened in memory (BinkOpen with BINKFROMMEMORY) (HBINK)

name: lobby_launch
comment: Set where a lobby launched the game: WinMain then plays neither the intro, the splash's movie, the hangar's nor the landing

name: chapter_of_mission
comment: The chapter each of missions 1 to 32 ends, 0 for none: missions 7, 11, 19, 21 and 25 end chapters 1 to 5; play_landing_movie indexes it by mission number from 0x00509BFF

name: chapter_movies
comment: Each chapter's movie for play_landing_movie: dummy.bik, then new_chapter1.bik to new_chapter5.bik

name: medal_of_mission
comment: The medal each mission awards, by mission number, 0 for none (mission_end_record): missions 6, 11, 16, 21, 23 and 27 award medals 1 to 6 where the mission is rated a success with its bonus

name: medal_movies
comment: Each medal's ceremony, medals 1 to 6 (mission_end_record indexes it from 0x00500A04): new_silver.bik, new_black eagle.bik, new_valour.bik, new_legion.bik, new_navy_cross.bik and new_medal_of_honour.bik

name: vr_rooms
comment: The Reliant's rooms, the Yamato's after mission 18, from view: each view's way in and loop from the disc's archive (vr_movie), the hotspots that lead on and each view's action; Escape opens in_game_options. Through the briefing room's door it runs the briefing (interface_run 7) and returns 1 to fly the mission; 0 for the main menu

name: vr_draw
comment: The rooms' render hook: the movie's frame due, looping or arriving at its last; the crew; the label of the exit under the pointer, the news report's or the fish food's; the food falling; the pointer

name: news_report
comment: The news report on the rooms' television: the scene of the next mission's number (%s.box, from a table on the stack) spoken over rel_tv_in_loop.bik, or b_tv_news_.bik on the Yamato, mission 1's in three parts; ends on Escape, either button or the speech's end

name: reliant_induction
comment: A new pilot's induction before mission 1's rooms: Enriquez's scenes (enr_intro.box to enr_outro.box) at the television, the locker, the simulator pod, the CD player, the ITAC and the television again, each over its movie, the ways between them played over the screen; Space or the speech's end moves on, Escape or the right button ends it. Returns the count of ways taken

name: induction_draw
comment: reliant_induction's render hook: its movie's frame due, back to the second at its last

name: in_game_options
comment: The in-game options over the rooms, interface\ingameop.tga with interface\frntend7.spr: SAVE, LOAD, AUDIO, CONTROL DEVICES, VIDEO, BACK, MAIN MENU, QUIT and ABOUT STARLANCER. Returns 0 for BACK or Escape, 1 once a game is loaded, -1 for the main menu

name: in_game_options_draw
comment: in_game_options' render hook: the buttons and their labels, the item under the pointer lit, the panels' labels, ABOUT STARLANCER's box, the dialogs and the pointer

name: about_box
comment: ABOUT STARLANCER: reads interface\frntend2.spr and shows its box over in_game_options (about_open) until Escape or a click on OK, once the button comes up

name: vr_crew_pick
comment: Picks the crew the rooms show on the way to the briefing room's door by how mission_number less 1 went: its medal by medal_of_mission, or a promotion, picks the first table; a mission_success of 0, or a pickup, the second; else the third. One of the carrier's table at random (rand), its sprite set (%s.spr) and line (%s.mp3) from the disc's archive; on the Yamato a second from yamato_second_crew, which yamato_crew_next goes round

name: vr_timer
type: void __stdcall (uint id, uint message, uint user, uint unused1, uint unused2)
comment: The rooms' timer, 15 times a second (timer_start): counts vr_timer_ticks up

name: speech_play
type: int __fastcall (SpeechHeader *file, uint flags, int rate, int volume)
comment: speech_start on the first stream free, or -1 for none: the news report's and the induction's scenes, and the briefing's words

name: itac
comment: The ITAC, which Use ITAC opens in the rooms (itac.cpp): its screens from inter\itac\, its fonts, sounds and movies

name: simulator_pod
comment: The simulator pod, which Enter Simulator Pod opens in the rooms, in a loop of its own: FLIGHT SIMULATOR leads to the training missions' screen through training.bik, to Instant Action, mission 29, or out; the training missions' screen to missions 31, 30 and 32, Instant Action or out. It flies a mission itself, in a Grendel, its kills and mission_number put back after it, then shows its screen again, FLIGHT SIMULATOR after Instant Action. The Yamato's pod opens and closes with hud_controls_up_.bik and hud_controls_down.bik

name: simulator_pod_draw
comment: The simulator pod's render hook (sr + 0x88): with the pointer over a choice, its lit shape from simgfx.spr and its name centred at (320, 440) in white in optfnt.fnt; the screen's title at (42, 85) in itacbig.fnt, FLIGHT SIMULATOR in 0xC18415 or Training Missions in 0x00E200; and the pointer, shape pointer_clock / 4 + 1 of vr_frontend_shapes

name: medal_display
comment: The locker, MedalDisplay by its assertions, which Open Locker opens in the rooms, in a loop of its own: on the Yamato lockzomi.bik first, then the lid going up (rel_locklup.bik, locklidup.bik), the medals and ribbons the pilot has coming into view frame by frame from (r)medal%d.spr and (r)bar%d.spr; once up, a button or Escape sends it down (rel_lockldo.bik, lokliddo.bik), and Escape or its end closes it. Three of the four lid movies open into bink_movie rather than vr_movie, which the drawing and the waits read

name: cd_player
comment: The CD player, which Use CD player opens in the rooms, in a loop of its own over rel_bunk2cd.tga, or brd2cd.tga after mission 18: twelve pieces of music\%s.wav for each carrier, a row clicked to choose one and again to play it, and the buttons of cdplay.spr to play, pause, stop, step, repeat, play at random, turn the volume and leave. A piece that ends is followed by the next while it plays. PLAY SELECTED TRACK alone takes the Yamato's list after mission 18; the rest take the Reliant's

name: audio_screen
comment: Screen 3, the audio settings, which GAME OPTIONS and the in-game options' AUDIO open

name: audio_screen_draw
comment: Screen 3's render hook: the sliders' labels, tracks and knobs (audio_knobs), 3D SOUND with its arrows, the one under the pointer lit (in_game_options_item), the provider's name, the buttons, the dialogs and the pointer

name: sound_3d_reopen
comment: Closes the 3D provider and opens sound_3d_provider's instead; where it won't open, opens provider 0 if fallback is set. Whether it opened

name: sound_3d_provider
comment: The 3D provider the audio screen chose, [Sound] 3DProvider: 0 Miles's own, 1 Aureal A3D, 2 Creative Labs EAX, 3 RSX

name: audio_items
comment: Screen 3's six items, a corner and a size each: RESET TO DEFAULT, OK, MAIN MENU, 3D SOUND's arrows back and on, CANCEL CHANGES

name: audio_knobs
comment: Screen 3's knobs, a corner and a size each, which move with their volumes: the effects', the music's, the speech's and the master's

name: audio_knob_held
comment: Which of screen 3's knobs the pointer holds, by audio_knobs' order

name: audio_knob_held_last
comment: audio_knob_held as it was last pass, whose effects' letting go tries the volume

name: options_held
comment: Set while the press that chose one of screen 3's items is down, and while screen 15's brightness knob is held

name: controls_screen
comment: Screen 16, the control devices, which GAME OPTIONS and the in-game options' CONTROL DEVICES open

name: controls_screen_draw
comment: Screen 16's render hook: the panes, the labels, dimmed where they can't be used, the 12 rows of controls_list from controls_first, the buttons, the one under the pointer lit, the check boxes, the arrows, the ticks, the dialogs and the pointer

name: controls_scroll_down
comment: Screen 16's list a row down, while its last row is not shown

name: controls_scroll_up
comment: Screen 16's list a row up, while its first row is not shown

name: controls_first
comment: The row of controls_list that screen 16's list shows first

name: controls_waiting
comment: The action whose row on screen 16 waits for a key or a joystick button, -1 for none

name: controls_arrow
comment: Screen 16's list arrow under the pointer, lit: 0 up, 1 down, -1 none

name: interface_button_lit
comment: The button under the pointer that screen 16 and a multiplayer screen (0x0043CA50) light, by its place in the screen's table; -1 for none

name: game_options
comment: Screen 1, GAME OPTIONS: AUDIO, CONTROL DEVICES and VIDEO by their icons, MAIN MENU, QUIT and ABOUT STARLANCER, over interface\main2opt.tga

name: game_options_draw
comment: GAME OPTIONS' render hook: the buttons, the item under the pointer lit (roster_item), the title and the labels, ABOUT STARLANCER's box, the dialogs and the pointer

name: key_names_english
comment: key_config_defaults' copy of key_names, by the executable's English names, which default.txt names the keys by

name: key_names_rename
comment: Renames every binding and every entry of key_names by the names the keyboard's layout gives them (key_name_get), and each of typing_characters but the space by what its key types; WinMain calls it as it starts

name: key_name_get
comment: The name the keyboard's layout gives the key of DirectInput scan code code, by GetKeyNameTextA, its extended flag set past 0x80, in size bytes; Unknown and false where Windows has none

name: typing_scan_codes
comment: The scan codes of typing_characters' keys: A to Z, the space bar, the period, the comma and 1 to 0

name: typing_characters

name: itac_text_colour

name: tooltips_close
comment: Closes newfont.fnt and frees itacgfx.spr

name: tooltips_clear

name: tooltips_update

comment: iff_close, then bin_file_destroy

comment: Frees the reader's form stack and closes its file

name: iff_rewind
comment: The reader to the first chunk of the form entered, or of the file, and its header read

comment: Reads the chunk header at the reader's position where it is short of the end of the form entered or of the file: the id, the size big-endian, and a FORM's type

name: iff_find_chunk

name: byte_swap32
comment: Reverses a dword's four bytes

name: bin_file_fatal
comment: Prints Fatal Error and the message, then exits the game

name: bin_file_open

comment: Keeps the name, 79 characters at most, upper-cased, and the mode, then opens the file (bin_file_open_now); fatal where a file is open already

name: bin_file_open_now

name: bin_file_close
comment: Closes the file where it is open; a failure is fatal

name: bin_file_read

name: bin_file_read_byte
comment: bin_file_read of one byte

name: bin_file_seek

name: bin_file_destroy
